jobs.title: Working Student System Administration (all genders)
jobs.description:
Working Student System Administration (all genders)

YOUR IMPACT - YOUR ROLE

Show us how you rock IT!

You juggle bits and bytes while others are still looking for their coffee cups? Then join our dynamic and modern company, where innovation and agility are lived. With us, you will have the opportunity to develop your skills further and be part of an international team.

For this, we are looking for you as our Working Student System Administration (all genders).

Your mission in detail:

  • As our Working Student System Administration, you are the contact person for all hardware and software problems and support the Helpling team with questions regarding the IT infrastructure in our Berlin office.
  • You support the provisioning and maintenance of our Windows- and OSX-based environment and help provide your colleagues with high-speed, bugless equipment.
  • You help manage our local networks and support troubleshooting, analysis, and documentation.
  • You bring your own ideas to improve existing workflows through customized automation.
  • You help ward off cyber attacks, create backups, and contribute to our overall IT security.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

A vocational training or degree is not the most important thing to us. We value your experience and are therefore looking for practically-versed, plug-and-play heroes with versatile IT knowledge who are currently enrolled at a university.

  • You are familiar with help desk user support, Google Workspace, setting up VLAN and VPN, as well as Windows and OSX systems, and ideally, you even bring first knowledge of a programming language.
  • You are reliable, motivated, and effortlessly juggle multiple inquiries at the same time.
  • You live in Berlin/Brandenburg and value our beautiful office in Berlin Mitte as your second 127.0.0.1
  • You are enrolled as a student throughout your time with us and can work up to 20 hours per week.
  • German language skills are a plus, very good English is a must.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US

Flexibility: Flexible working & an office in Berlin Mitte for networking and socializing

Personal development: you work in a small team that gives you the opportunity to bring in your individual strengths and ideas and actively shape the future of Helpling.

Growth: define your individual growth path with the help of our feedback cycle, leadership workshops, book club, or lunch & learns

Vacation: up to 30 vacation days per year, depending on length of service. In addition, we give away up to 10 additional vacation days per year in cool campaigns, e.g., advent calendar or health challenges

Family & Career: we pay you 5 additional child sick days per year when your child needs you

Company Pension Scheme: with up to 20% employer contribution

Focus on the essentials, we'll take care of the rest: we offer you a discount for your own domestic help via Helpling.de

APPLY NOW

If this role sounds like you, then send us your application documents, including your availability and proof of current enrollment.

We would like to encourage you to apply even if you do not yet meet 100% of our expectations listed above. For us, your personality and motivation are just as important as your professional qualifications.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, national origin, migration history, marital status, age, or disability.

jobs.title: Project Lead DXP I Composable DXP
jobs.description:
Project Lead DXP I Composable DXP

Wofür wir stehen:

“We drive digital transformation end-to-end - from strategy to execution. Creating measurable progress and real impact for our clients.”

Stillstand? Nicht mit uns. Wir glauben: Alles ist BETA und genau darin liegt die Chance für Fortschritt. Darum hinterfragen wir Bestehendes, wagen Neues und gestalten die digitale Transformation unserer Kunden aktiv mit.
Was uns auszeichnet? Wir denken ganzheitlich. Von der strategischen Beratung bis zur Implementierung begleiten wir unsere Kunden End-to-End – mit Kreativität, technologischer Exzellenz und einem tiefen Verständnis für ihre Geschäftsmodelle. So entstehen messbarer Fortschritt und nachhaltiger Impact.

Und jetzt kommst du: Wir suchen Menschen mit Neugier, Ambition und dem Mut, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Menschen, die Lust haben, Neues zu lernen, unsere Kunden zu begeistern und gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du leitest große DXP-Projekte eigenverantwortlich, vom Kick-off bis zum Go-live und darüber hinaus.
  • Du steuerst Budget, Ressourcen und Scope und behältst die Wirtschaftlichkeit deiner Projekte im Blick.
  • Du bist erste Ansprechperson für deine Kund:innen auf Management- und Fachebene und führst auch schwierige Gespräche souverän.
  • Du berätst deine Kund:innen aktiv und bist ihr Trusted Advisor für die Anforderungen im Projekt.
  • Du erkennst Risiken früh, sprichst sie offen an und treibst Lösungen aktiv voran, bevor daraus Eskalationen werden.
  • Du führst interdisziplinäre Projektteams aus Development, UX und Consulting und schaffst Klarheit, wo Komplexität entsteht.
  • Du hast genug technisches Verständnis, um Architekturentscheidungen im Composable-DXP-Umfeld mitzutragen und zu hinterfragen.
  • Gemeinsam mit dem PM-Team entwickelst du unsere Delivery-Standards weiter.

Damit kannst Du punkten:

  • 5–7 Jahre Agenturerfahrung als Projektmanager:in oder Projektleiter:in
  • Nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Leitung von DXP-Projekten, idealerweise im Composable-Stack
  • Sichere Steuerung von Budgets, Ressourcen und Scope
  • Erfahrung im Eskalationsmanagement und souveräner Umgang mit anspruchsvollen Stakeholdern
  • Fließendes Deutsch, da wir uns im anspruchsvollen Business-Kontext mit vornehmlich deutschsprachigen Kunden bewegen

Damit punktest du zusätzlich:

  • Projekterfahrung mit Commerce, PIM oder DAM (z. B. Spryker, Pimcore, Emporix)
  • PM-Zertifizierung (IPMA, PMI o. ä.)
  • Fließendes Englisch

Was wir von Dir benötigen:

Mission started?! Dann brauchen wir von Dir:

  • Deinen CV
  • Welche Vergütung Du Dir für Deine Performance vorstellst
  • Deine Kündigungsfrist bzw. möglicher Starttermin

Warum wir?

Wir glauben: Wer viel gibt, soll auch viel zurückbekommen . Deshalb erwarten dich bei uns Benefits, die über „Extras“ hinausgehen. Sie geben dir Freiheit, Flexibilität und die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln, und machen deinen Arbeitsalltag einfach besser.

  • T eamspirit pur: Kollegiale Teams mit echtem Zusammenhalt, Hilfsbereitschaft und einer guten Portion Humor.
  • Transparente Strukturen: Flache Hierarchien und eine gelebte Open-Door-Mentalität - Austausch auf Augenhöhe ist selbstverständlich.
  • Open Vacation Policy: Neben deinen gesetzlichen Urlaubstagen kannst du dir mit unserer „Above & Beyond“-Regelung zusätzliche freie Tage gönnen.
  • Work from anywhere: Ob Home-Office oder temporär im Ausland - du entscheidest, wo du am produktivsten bist.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Großer Gleitzeitrahmen - du bestimmst deinen Rhythmus, mit Verlässlichkeit bei Kunden- und Teammeetings.
  • Modelle, die zu deinem Leben passen: Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, fix oder zeitlich begrenzt – wir finden gemeinsam die passende Lösung.
  • Spannende Projekte, innovativ, abwechslungsreich und mit steiler Lernkurve – bei uns gestaltest du echten Fortschritt mit.
  • Wachstum garantiert: Individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget für Workshops, Zertifizierungen oder Coachings.
  • Karrierepfade: Auch bei flachen Hierarchien sorgen klare Strukturen für deine Weiterentwicklung.
  • Mobility & Events: Bis zu 467 € fürs Öffi- oder Deutschlandticket, regelmäßige Teamevents und Besuche von Messen & Conventions.
  • Loft-Offices: Zentral gelegen, modern ausgestattet, kreativ – mit Raum für Austausch, Ideen und natürlich Snacks & Drinks.
  • Rewards:Prämiensystem für deine persönlichen und unternehmerischen Erfolge. Diese Position ist im Cluster Solution von TOWA auf . Manager-Level angesiedelt. Das Gehalt liegt zwischen €70.000 und €95.000 brutto/Jahr (All-in). Die angegebene Range umfasst alle Gehaltsbestandteile und ist als Zielgehalt zu verstehen (z. B. inklusive variabler Anteile oder weiterer Benefits, sofern zutreffend). Im Falle einer Zusammenarbeit erstellen wir dir ein individuelles Angebot – die Einstufung innerhalb der Range richtet sich nach deinen Skills, deinem Verantwortungsbereich und deiner Erfahrung, niemals nach deinem vorherigen Gehalt.
    Im Einklang mit der EU-Entgelttransparenzrichtlinie (2023/970) und den länderspezifischen Gleichbehandlungsgesetzen veröffentlichen wir für jede Rolle die Gehaltsspanne und fragen Kandidat:innen nicht nach ihrem aktuellen oder vorherigen Gehalt. Unsere Kriterien zur Gehaltsfestlegung – Cluster, Level, Skills, Verantwortungsbereich und Erfahrung – gelten unternehmensweit einheitlich. Du kannst während des gesamten Prozesses jederzeit schriftlich weitere Informationen zur Gehaltsspanne dieser Rolle oder zu unserer Vergütungspolitik anfordern.
    Chancengleichheit
    TOWA stellt nach Skills und Impact ein. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen aller qualifizierten Personen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Hintergrund, Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Orientierung oder Behinderung. Die Stellenbezeichnung gilt für alle Geschlechter (m/w/d).

Deine Führungskraft

Intelligent Automation Engineering Lead

Role: Intelligent Automation Engineering Lead
Employment Type: Fixed Term Contract – 6 Months
Location: Hybrid / Remote (London)

Role Overview:

We are looking for an experienced Intelligent Automation Engineering Lead to help accelerate the adoption of AI across engineering teams and client environments. This role is focused on enabling teams to successfully design, deliver, and scale AI solutions by providing technical leadership, guidance, and support across a variety of technology landscapes.

You will work closely with Delta Capita engineering teams, client stakeholders, architects, and delivery teams to identify AI opportunities, shape solutions, and support the implementation of AI-enabled products and services. The role requires someone who is comfortable operating across cloud platforms, engineering disciplines, and enterprise systems, helping teams navigate both technical and operational considerations.

Rather than being a traditional people management role, this position is suited to someone who enjoys collaborating with engineers, facilitating technical discussions, solving complex problems, and helping teams adopt practical AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Partner with engineering teams to identify, assess, and deliver AI and automation opportunities across the organisation.

  2. Provide technical guidance on Generative AI, AI Agents, LLMs, automation platforms, and emerging AI technologies.

  3. Act as a trusted advisor to development, infrastructure, architecture, and product teams throughout the AI solution lifecycle.

  4. Facilitate technical discussions between Delta Capita and client teams to align on architecture, delivery approaches, and AI adoption strategies.

  5. Support engineering teams working across Python, Azure, AWS, infrastructure, and enterprise applications.

  6. Review solution designs and provide recommendations on scalability, security, operational resilience, and maintainability.

  7. Advise on AI governance, security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI practices.

  8. Help define and promote engineering best practices, standards, SDLC processes, governance frameworks, and reusable patterns to support the successful delivery of AI solutions.

  9. Collaborate with Architecture, Security, CloudOps, and Product teams to ensure AI solutions align with enterprise standards.

  10. Support teams throughout design, development, testing, deployment, and operational support phases.

  11. Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and business outcomes through AI.

  12. Drive knowledge sharing and capability development across engineering teams.


Essential Skills & Experience

  1. Strong background in Software Engineering, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or Technical Consulting.

  2. Experience delivering enterprise-grade technology solutions within large-scale environments.

  3. Good understanding of Generative AI concepts including:

    • AI Agents

    • Large Language Models (LLMs)

    • Prompt Engineering

    • Context Engineering

    • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

    • Tool/Function Calling

    • Responsible AI Practices

  4. Experience supporting engineering teams through the full Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).

  5. Strong understanding of cloud platforms, particularly Azure and/or AWS.

  6. Experience working with Python and modern engineering practices.

  7. Strong communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  8. Ability to balance innovation with practical business and operational requirements.

  9. Experience working within Agile delivery environments.

Desirable Experience

  1. Experience building or supporting AI Agents, AI Assistants, Copilots, or AI Enablement Platforms.

  2. Knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol) and enterprise AI integration frameworks.

  3. Experience with AI governance, evaluation frameworks, observability, and LLMOps.

  4. Experience with enterprise integration technologies, APIs, middleware, and event-driven architectures.

  5. Hands-on experience across both Azure and AWS cloud environments.

  6. Familiarity with GitLab CI/CD or similar DevOps toolchains.

  7. Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Splunk.

  8. Experience within Financial Services, FinTech, Payments, or other highly regulated environments.

  9. Understanding of security, risk, compliance, and governance frameworks supporting enterprise AI adoption.

How We Work:  

Delta Capita is an equal opportunity employer. We positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of age, colour, disability, national origin, ancestry, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require any reasonable adjustments through your interview process, please use the designated space within the application questionnaire.  

This is a FTC/Contract position located in London with hybrid working. As the selection and interview process is ongoing, please submit your application in English as soon as possible, if your profile is selected, a member of our team will contact you within 4 weeks. For this role, a valid working permit for the UK is mandatory.  

Expectations regarding hybrid working: As we are a Service Provider and Consulting firm servicing clients, our policy for physically working from the office (which may be the clients' offices or our own offices depending on the client) aligns to what our clients' policies and expectations are and these vary. Most of our clients now require a minimum of 3 days per week in the office, 2 days from home, and accordingly this is also the minimum expectation that Delta Capita require.

Embedded Electrical Engineer - SoM

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the role

As an Embedded Electrical Engineer at Harmattan AI, you will join the R&D team to design the compute modules and associated boards used across our platforms. You will own these designs end-to-end, from system architecture and schematic through layout guidance, fabrication, bring-up, and qualification. This is a high-impact role that combines demanding high-speed design work with hands-on bench work, taking hardware from a first prototype through to boards that fly.

Responsibilities

  • Board Design: Design SoMs, baseboards, and test boards for our compute platforms.

  • High-Speed Digital Design: Design around high-end application processors, covering PCIe, 10 Gb Ethernet, USB 3.x, and MIPI, managing layout constraints and signal integrity.

  • Power Design: Design power trees, sequencing, and conversion topologies, and verify power-up and power-down behaviour.

  • Design Reviews: Prepare and lead design reviews at each milestone, from block diagram to release for fabrication.

  • Manufacture: Work with PCB and EMS partners on stack-up, via technology, layout guidance, and cost trade-offs.

  • Bring Up and Qualification: Define verification test plans, troubleshoot and characterise boards, and run thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with the embedded software team through board bring-up, the mechanical team on form factor and thermal constraints, and validation for flight qualification.

Candidate requirements

  • Educational Background: MSc in electrical, computer, or a related engineering field. A PhD is a plus. A hands-on design and bring-up record matters more than the specific degree.

  • Experience: 5 years minimum in embedded hardware design, with boards taken from specification through bring-up and qualification into production.

  • Technical Expertise: High-speed design including layout constraints, signal integrity, and validation. Systems built around a processor with external memory (DDR, Flash) are carried through to a committed layout. Power trees with deliberate conversion topologies and verified power-up and power-down behaviour.

  • Tools: In-depth knowledge of electronic CAD tools (e.g., Altium).

  • Testing Proficiency: Proficiency with electronic test equipment and experience planning thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification.

  • Manufacturing: Experience working with fabrication and assembly partners on stack-up, via technology, and cost trade-offs.

  • Problem Solving: Rigorous, structured, and analytical; able to work autonomously and see a board from concept through to production.

  • Communication and Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication, able to present design and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders.

  • Additional Skills: FPGA or MPSoC design, prior work deploying AI inference on embedded targets, and UAS, drone, or defence hardware experience are strong advantages.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. Thrives in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and no task is too small.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the role

As an Embedded Electrical Engineer at Harmattan AI, you will join the R&D team to design the compute modules and associated boards used across our platforms. You will own these designs end-to-end, from system architecture and schematic through layout guidance, fabrication, bring-up, and qualification. This is a high-impact role that combines demanding high-speed design work with hands-on bench work, taking hardware from a first prototype through to boards that fly.

Responsibilities

  • Board Design: Design SoMs, baseboards, and test boards for our compute platforms.

  • High-Speed Digital Design: Design around high-end application processors, covering PCIe, 10 Gb Ethernet, USB 3.x, and MIPI, managing layout constraints and signal integrity.

  • Power Design: Design power trees, sequencing, and conversion topologies, and verify power-up and power-down behaviour.

  • Manufacture: Work with PCB and EMS partners on stack-up, via technology, layout guidance, and cost trade-offs.

  • Bring Up and Qualification: Define verification test plans, troubleshoot and characterise boards, and run thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with the embedded software team through board bring-up, the mechanical team on form factor and thermal constraints, and validation for flight qualification.

Candidate requirements

  • Educational Background: MSc in electrical, computer, or a related engineering field. A PhD is a plus. A hands-on design and bring-up record matters more than the specific degree.

  • Experience: 5 years minimum in embedded hardware design, with boards taken from specification through bring-up and qualification into production.

  • Technical Expertise: High-speed design including layout constraints, signal integrity, and validation. Systems built around a processor with external memory (DDR, Flash) are carried through to a committed layout. Power trees with deliberate conversion topologies and verified power-up and power-down behaviour.

  • Tools: In-depth knowledge of electronic CAD tools (e.g., Altium).

  • Testing Proficiency: Proficiency with electronic test equipment and experience planning thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification.

  • Manufacturing: Experience working with fabrication and assembly partners on stack-up, via technology, and cost trade-offs.

  • Problem Solving: Rigorous, structured, and analytical; able to work autonomously and see a board from concept through to production.

  • Communication and Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication, able to present design and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders.

  • Additional Skills: FPGA or MPSoC design, prior work deploying AI inference on embedded targets, and UAS, drone, or defence hardware experience are strong advantages.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. Thrives in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and no task is too small.

Account Manager (Email Marketing)

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Manager (Email Marketing) based in Switzerland.

This role offers the opportunity to take full ownership of a portfolio of DTC e-commerce client accounts within a fast-growing email marketing agency.
You’ll serve as the primary client contact, ensuring communication stays clear, proactive, and focused on delivering strong outcomes.
You’ll coordinate copywriters, designers, and implementers, planning work ahead and keeping projects moving from brief through delivery.
You’ll also review campaigns, flows, pop-ups, and reports to ensure work meets client expectations and brand requirements.
Using platforms such as Klaviyo and Omnisend, you’ll monitor account performance and turn insights into actionable recommendations.
The role combines client management, project coordination, quality control, and lifecycle marketing expertise in a highly collaborative remote environment.
With significant ownership from day one, you’ll play an important role in helping the team scale while strengthening client relationships and results.


Accountabilities

  • Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, maintaining clear, proactive communication through Slack and email.

  • Take end-to-end ownership of client work, ensuring projects move efficiently from briefing and planning through execution and delivery.

  • Plan upcoming work for both one-time projects and ongoing retainer accounts, ensuring priorities and deadlines remain clear.

  • Allocate daily tasks across copywriters, designers, and implementers according to project requirements and team capacity.

  • Review deliverables before they reach clients, including email flows, campaigns, pop-ups, and performance reports, ensuring they align with briefs and brand standards.

  • Maintain clear visibility of priorities, deadlines, responsibilities, and handoffs using project-management and documentation tools.

  • Monitor account performance through Klaviyo, Omnisend, and analytics platforms, translating results into actionable next steps and clear client updates.

  • Use AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT to support drafting, planning, summarization, and other account-management workflows where appropriate.

  • Help identify opportunities to improve client outcomes, delivery processes, and team efficiency.

  • Contribute to a positive, energetic team culture and support the team as the client portfolio continues to grow.

  • Take ownership of account performance and delivery, ensuring client work is completed on time and agreed objectives are addressed.

  • Progress toward increasing levels of independence, from learning the agency and accounts initially to independently managing planning, reviews, and client relationships.

    • Requirements

    • At least 2 years of experience working at an agency, ideally in an account management, client services, or similar client-facing role.

    • Strong experience communicating directly with clients, with excellent written communication skills and a clear, warm, and professional approach.

    • Solid understanding of the e-commerce lifecycle journey and how email and SMS channels work together from first website visit through repeat purchase.

    • Practical knowledge of email marketing activities including flows, campaigns, pop-ups, and performance reporting.

    • Familiarity with Klaviyo and Omnisend, as well as collaboration and project-management tools such as Slack, ClickUp, and Notion.

    • Comfortable using AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT to improve productivity and support day-to-day account management.

    • Experience with Hiro Analytics or similar marketing analytics platforms is an advantage.

    • Knowledge of peptide or supplement brands is a plus but is not required.

    • Strong ownership mentality, with the ability to manage responsibilities independently and proactively identify what needs to happen next.

    • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong prioritization and creative problem-solving skills.

    • Ability to work effectively under pressure while maintaining quality, deadlines, and client communication.

    • Collaborative team player who enjoys working closely with colleagues and contributing to a growing team.

    • Comfortable working in an environment where feedback is informal, continuous, and integrated into active projects.

    • Availability to work approximately 8 hours per day, Monday through Friday, aligned with Eastern Time.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive compensation based on experience and location.

      • Fully remote, remote-first working environment.

      • Full-time contractor position with international exposure.

      • Opportunity to manage a portfolio of approximately 27 active DTC e-commerce accounts across multiple industries.

      • Direct ownership of client accounts and significant responsibility from day one.

      • Direct reporting relationship with the agency founder.

      • Opportunity to work alongside copywriters, designers, and implementation specialists.

      • Exposure to e-commerce brands across supplements, health and beauty, fashion, athletic wear, and skincare.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Curriculum
jobs.description:
Senior Director of Curriculum

CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 40,000 students from 1,000+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We've spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world.

We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work.

We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0-to-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it.

About the Role

Location: Remote, United States

Role Type: Full-Time

Reporting to: Chief Product Officer

Total Compensation: $165,000 to $239,000 per year

  • Base salary: $165,000 to $200,000
  • Total compensation includes the base salary plus a guaranteed supplement

The Senior Director of Curriculum is a senior leadership role responsible for the vision, strategy, and execution of CodePath’s entire curriculum portfolio. You will set long-term curriculum direction while directly shaping high-impact courses, particularly in AI-native software engineering, technical interview preparation, cybersecurity, and web development.

You will partner closely with Learning (Programs & Student Experience), Engineering, Platform, Revenue, and Employer Partnerships to ensure CodePath courses remain rigorous, engaging, and aligned to rapidly evolving industry needs. You will own the systems, processes, roadmap and initially manage a small, high-impact team and own hiring as the function scales that allow CodePath to move faster without compromising quality.

Check out our Course Catalog and our 2024 Annual Report to learn more!

Software engineering is changing faster than traditional academic programs can adapt. Generative AI is reshaping how engineers design, build, debug, and ship software—and employers increasingly expect new graduates to be AI-native from day one.

As Director of Curriculum, you will define how CodePath bridges the gap between academic computer science programs and industry expectations. You will lead the transition to a more modular, flexible curriculum architecture that enables rapid iteration, targeted updates, and new delivery models across:

  • Undergraduate, for-credit university partnerships

  • Undergraduate, Direct-to-student programs

  • Employer-focused upskilling and reskilling offerings

Our programs, run both online and in-person, begin with inspiration and build toward technical excellence and practical mastery, supported by learning pathways and strong student support systems. Our curriculum is grounded in proven learning principles — proper leveling, balanced pacing, spaced repetition, blended synchronous and asynchronous learning, peer collaboration, and project-based work.

You will define how we prepare students to become AI-native software engineers and steward our course portfolio to support CodePath’s growth from 20,000 to 100,000 students per year.

Key Responsibilities

Curriculum Strategy & Portfolio Ownership

  • Lead CodePath’s long-term curriculum strategy and transition to a modular, flexible architecture that supports AI- native skills, rapid iteration, and multiple delivery models

  • Own the curriculum product roadmap, maintaining 12-month visibility into new courses, major revisions, and portfolio investments

  • Maintain and evolve a comprehensive course catalog across Web Development, Mobile Development, Cybersecurity, Technical Interview Prep, Foundational CS, and AI-native offerings

Course Development & Quality

  • Lead the design and launch of new courses aligned to emerging industry needs, particularly in AI-native engineering and applied AI workflows

  • Oversee ongoing maintenance, revision, and improvement of existing courses to ensure relevance, rigor, and student impact

  • Ensure curriculum combines rigorous learning science with real-world engineering practice, clear career pathways, and applied experiences including open-source and industry-aligned projects

Team Leadership & Operations

  • Build, manage, and develop a high-performing curriculum team, including full-time staff and external contractors

  • Establish clear processes for curriculum planning, development, QA, feedback, and continuous improvement

  • Partner with senior leadership to forecast hiring needs and scale curriculum capacity in line with organizational growth

Cross-Functional & External Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Learning to ensure curriculum translates effectively into classroom delivery, aligned pedagogy, and student experience

  • Collaborate with Engineering to align curriculum with tooling, content systems, and delivery infrastructure within the CodePath Platform

  • Represent CodePath externally with university partners, employers, funders, and at industry events, clearly articulating curriculum quality and rigor

Key Success Metrics

12–18 Month Success Outcomes

You will be successful in this role if, within your first 12–18 months, you:

  • Establish a clear, opinionated curriculum strategy and modular architecture that reduces the amount of resources required to develop and launch and maintain curriculum by incorporating AI-first curriculum process/tooling

  • Refresh or significantly improve the majority of the existing course catalog with targeted improvements, raising the overall quality bar

  • Launch 2-3 new AI-focused courses that meet industry expectations, strong student satisfaction, and learning outcome benchmarks. Completion (70%), Job attainment (60%) and student NPS (50-60) are expected to be upheld or improved upon

  • Improve curriculum alignment with delivery, contributing to higher completion rates, clearer value propositions, and stronger student confidence entering internships and full-time roles

  • Build a scalable, disciplined curriculum function that is capable of accelerating CodePath’s continued growth and improving quality with successful hiring of two new FTEs and onboarding of key resources

Qualifications

Required

  • Strong software engineering background with the technical credibility to shape CS and AI-native curriculum

  • Demonstrated excellence in curriculum design, computer science education, or instructional leadership

  • Experience owning end-to-end technical curriculum used by thousands of learners, from design through iteration and measurable outcomes

  • Experience or excitement to incorporate an AI-first curriculum process/tooling that accelerates and improves quality

  • Proven ability to lead and develop teams, including managing full-time staff and contractors

  • Deep understanding of the computer science degree journey and the gap between academic preparation and industry expectations

  • First-principles thinker with evidence-based curriculum expertise, high ownership, and a bias towards action grounded with disciplined execution

Preferred

  • Experience designing AI-native, GenAI, or applied ML curriculum

  • Familiarity with open-source software development or community-based contribution models

  • Experience operating in fast-growing, mission-driven organizations

  • Exposure to platform-based or large-scale learning environments

Compensation

CodePath has standardized salaries based on the position’s level, no matter where you live. For this role, we’re hiring for a Senior Director level position at an annual salary of $165,000 to $200,000. Total compensation is $165,000 to $239,000, which includes base salary plus a guaranteed supplement. Salary is determined based on your relevant experience and skills as evaluated through our interview process.

Full-Time Employee Benefits:

This is a 100% remote position—work from anywhere in the U.S.! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program

  • Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection

  • Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2)

  • Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support

  • ​​Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt

  • Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings

Pay range

$163,000—$239,000 USD

Dann wartet in unserem Team in Berlin deine nächste große Challenge auf dich: Bei benuta übernimmst du echte Ownership über unsere Kanäle hinweg und treibst ein echtes Greenfield-Thema voran – die Skalierung KI-gestützter Analysen und Strategien für den europäischen Marktführer im Home-&-Living-Bereich!

Deine Aufgaben

  • Strategische Kanal- & Budgetsteuerung: Du entwickelst und verantwortest die kanalübergreifende Performance-Marketing-Strategie via MMM zur Erreichung unserer Unternehmensziele (Umsatz, Effizienz, Lead-Gen, Brand Awareness). Du steuerst und optimierst Kampagnen über Google Ads, Bing Ads, Meta, Pinterest, Reddit Ads sowie Affiliate-Partnerschaften mit einer konsistenten Budget- und Ziellogik.
  • AI-Integration & Workflow-Innovation: Du treibst den Einsatz von LLMs (z. B. Claude, Gemini) für die automatisierte, kanalübergreifende Analyse unserer Kampagnendaten aktiv voran. Du entwickelst Prompts und Workflows für beschleunigtes Reporting, Anomalie-Erkennung sowie Budget-Optimierungen und agierst als interner Expert für KI-gestützte Marketing-Tools.
  • Analyse & Bidding-Evaluierung: Du überwachst und analysierst alle relevanten KPIs (CPO, ROAS, CAC, Conversion Rate) auf Basis von GA4 und unserem serverseitigen Tracking-Setup (server-side GTM). Zudem bewertest du KI-gestützte Bidding- und Automatisierungsfunktionen der Werbeplattformen auf ihren Mehrwert.
  • Tracking-Setup & Datensicherheit: Du implementierst und verwaltest Tracking-Setups (z. B. Conversion-APIs, UTM-Konventionen) und stellst eine saubere, datenschutzkonforme Datengrundlage sicher.
  • Testing: Du verantwortest fortlaufende A/B-Tests und Budget-Experimente zur kontinuierlichen Performance-Steigerung aller Kanäle.
  • Partner-Management & Kollaboration: Du verhandelst und entwickelst Vendor- und Partnerverträge (z. B. im Affiliate-Bereich) weiter. Bei der Kampagnenabstimmung arbeitest du eng mit den Teams aus Design, Content und IT zusammen.
  • Mentoring: Du unterstützt bei der fachlichen Anleitung sowie dem Onboarding von Junior-Kolleg*innen im Team und teilst dein KI-Wissen.

Stellenanforderungen

Dein Profil

  • Ausbildung: Du hast dein Studium (BWL, Marketing, Medien, Kommunikationswissenschaften o. Ä.) erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder bringst eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit.
  • Relevante Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Marketing mit – idealerweise kanalübergreifend (SEA, Paid Social, Affiliate) und mit nachweisbarer Budget- oder Teilprojektverantwortung. Erste Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung ist von Vorteil.
  • AI-Expertise (Must-have): Du besitzt praxiserprobte Erfahrung im Einsatz von KI-Tools und LLMs im Marketing-Kontext (z. B. Prompting für Reporting, Analysen, Forecasting). Du verfolgst aktuelle AI-Trends aktiv und brennst darauf, diese bei benuta einzubringen.
  • Hard Skills: Du zeichnest dich durch ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten aus, nutzt GA4 sowie gängige Attributions-/Reporting-Tools souverän und hast tiefe Kenntnisse in mindestens einem Zentralkanal (Google Ads, Meta). Erfahrung mit Bing, Pinterest, Reddit, Affiliate und serverseitigem Tracking runden dein Profil ab.
  • Soft Skills: Du arbeitest datengetrieben, denkst lösungsorientiert und begeisterst dich für E-Commerce sowie die Themen Home & Living.
  • Sprachkompetenz: Deine Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind sehr gut (weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus).

Deine Benefits

  • Impact & Gestaltungsspielraum: Bei uns kannst du aktiv mitgestalten, die Marke benuta weiterentwickeln und spannende KI-Projekte umsetzen – wie etwa den Aufbau KI-gestützter Analyse-Workflows für unsere Kampagnendaten. Deine Ideen werden gehört und du bekommst Freiraum für die Umsetzung eigener Ansätze.
  • Präsenz & Flexibilität: Der Schwerpunkt unserer Arbeit liegt auf dem persönlichen Austausch und der gemeinsamen Zusammenarbeit vor Ort an unserem Standort in Berlin. Für die nötige Flexibilität in deiner Alltagsplanung - sei es für private Termine oder ungestörtes Arbeiten - bieten wir dir ein jährliches Kontingent von 26 Home-Office-Tagen.
  • Deine Mobilität: Egal wie du zu uns kommst, wir unterstützen dich. Du hast die Wahl zwischen einem vergünstigten Jobticket oder einer Tankkarte. Zudem bieten wir dir ein Firmenrad-Leasing (JobRad) und eine gute ÖPNV-Anbindung.
  • Zeit für Erholung: Du erhältst 28 Tage Urlaub und profitierst von unserem flexiblen Gleitzeitmodell. Weihnachten und Silvester sind bei uns grundsätzlich arbeitsfreie Tage, die nicht von deinem Urlaubskonto abgehen.
  • Deine Entwicklung: Unsere unterschiedlichen Abteilungen mit internationalen Teams arbeiten an vielfältigen Projekten zusammen. Dadurch lernst Du permanent neue Sichtweisen, Tools und Prozesse kennen – inklusive aktuellster KI-Anwendungen im Performance Marketing.
  • Kultur & Mitarbeitervorteile: Ein strukturiertes Onboarding, flache Hierarchien und attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte warten auf dich. Bei uns gilt: Come as you are – fühl dich wohl und sei einfach du selbst!

Klingt nach deinem nächsten Match? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Lade einfach deinen Lebenslauf und deine relevanten Zeugnisse über unser Online-Portal hoch.

Dein Ansprechpartner ist Michael Stanke (Head of Online Marketing).

*Bei uns zählt der Mensch und seine Motivation - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion oder sexueller Orientierung. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit einer Schwerbehinderung oder ihnen Gleichgestellten werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt.

Über benuta

Seit 2008 revolutionieren wir von Bonn aus den europäischen Teppich- und Home-&-Living-E-Commerce. Mit über 100 Millionen Euro Umsatz, modernster AI-gestützter Produktinszenierung und Kunden in 17 Ländern verbinden wir die Sicherheit eines etablierten Marktführers mit dem Drive und den flachen Hierarchien eines Digital-Pioneers. Unser Ziel ist einfach: Jedes Zuhause noch schöner zu machen. Werde Teil unseres Teams und hilf uns dabei, noch mehr Menschen für unsere Produkte zu begeistern.

Finance Process & Systems Lead
jobs.description:
Finance Process & Systems Lead

Finance Process & Systems Lead

Our mission for you

Build the systems and process backbone of the Finance function in one of the most complex industries – and shape how Finance can be run differently.

trawa is transforming how mid-sized companies access green, intelligent energy. That means building in a market shaped by decades-old logic, extensive regulation, and highly complex data structures: 15-minute time series, PPAs, spot, futures, and direct marketing. All of this needs to flow into Finance in a way that is accurate, efficient, and scalable.

We're looking for a Finance Process & Systems Lead to take real ownership of how Finance operates, scales, and automates at trawa. This is a blue-sky role: you'll design our system landscape, redesign core processes end to end, lead the Finance side of our ERP rollout, and turn AI and automation from side experiments into core infrastructure.

You'll work closely with the Finance team across all functions, as well as Business Operations, Tech, Data, and other key stakeholders, to build the foundations that allow Finance to scale with the business.

What you'll own

Finance systems and IT transformation

  • Own trawa's Finance technology stack end to end – from today's fragmented landscape to a fully integrated stack built around a modern cloud ERP.

  • Lead the broader Finance IT transformation, including architecture, vendor selection, integrations, and the roadmap for our ERP, billing system, and future Finance tools.

  • Drive requirements, implementation, and go-live from the systems side. For accounting-heavy topics, you'll work closely with the Accounting Lead, who brings the required technical depth.

Process redesign, automation, and AI

Your biggest lever in the first 12 months will be to structurally redesign Quote-to-Cash for our energy business.

  • Redesign our core Finance processes end to end – including Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and Record-to-Report – with scalability, controls by design, and automation built in from the start.

  • Own the automation roadmap: define what gets automated, in which order, and with what expected return on investment.

  • Drive month-end close automation and establish time to close as a measurable performance indicator.

  • Turn AI and workflow automation into reliable Finance infrastructure rather than isolated experiments.

Data and the Finance–Tech bridge

  • Own Finance master data and the Finance layer of our data warehouse, from source systems and governance through to reporting-ready tables.

  • Translate energy-specific data – including time series, accruals, and portfolio pricing – into Finance-grade structures together with Tech, Data, and Business Operations.

  • Establish the data models, governance, and quality standards that enable reliable reporting and scalable Finance processes.

Your first 90 days

  • Month 1 – Understand and map: Get deep into our business model, the energy market, and our Finance systems and process landscape. Meet key stakeholders across Finance, Business Operations, Tech, and Data. Map Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and Record-to-Report end to end, and identify the most critical system and data pain points.

  • Month 2 – Take first ownership: Own the automation roadmap and deliver one meaningful automation or process improvement. Take ownership of Finance master data governance and begin scoping the strategic IT landscape and Finance transformation.

  • Month 3 – Own the roadmap: Own the Finance systems, process, and automation roadmap end to end. Present a concrete direction and rollout plan for the IT transformation. Define the target data model together with the relevant cross-functional stakeholders.

Who you are

Must-haves

  • 6+ years of experience in Finance Systems, Finance Processes, or FinOps in a fast-growing scale-up. You've built and improved systems and processes – not just operated them.

  • A proven track record of redesigning Quote-to-Cash in a complex environment with multiple product logics, numerous data sources, high volumes, and regulatory complexity. You also have a solid understanding of Procure-to-Pay and Record-to-Report.

  • Hands-on ERP implementation experience with a modern cloud ERP. You've personally owned requirements, process design, data migration, cutover, or hypercare.

  • Technical fluency to build, not just specify: You use SQL and Python in live workflows and are comfortable working with REST APIs, webhooks, and direct data access rather than relying only on standard reports.

  • An AI-first mindset with a track record: You've redesigned real processes using AI agents and workflow automation and have hands-on experience with tools such as Claude Code, n8n, or comparable solutions.

  • Experience designing master data and data warehouse structures: You've established Finance data models, governance, and quality rules and worked with Tech or BI to build a commercially usable data warehouse layer, from source systems through to reporting-ready tables.

  • An ownership mindset and business-fluent English.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience in the energy market, utilities, or trading. This will noticeably reduce your time to value.

  • An accounting qualification or background, such as CPA, ACCA, Bilanzbuchhalter:in, or Wirtschaftsprüfer:in.

  • German language skills.

Don't worry if you don't match every box. We value ownership, build instinct, and learning speed over perfect CVs.

What we offer

  • Blue-sky design authority: Work in one of Europe's most complex energy markets, with the opportunity to design Finance infrastructure from the ground up rather than maintain a legacy stack or legacy processes.

  • A role that grows with the company: trawa is scaling fast, and our Finance organisation is scaling with it. This role comes with genuine headroom: as the function grows around you, so do your scope, your team, and your seniority.

  • The opportunity to lead the Finance side of our ERP rollout: a milestone that will shape the company for the next decade.

  • The chance to build a truly AI-first Finance stack.

  • Direct contact with our founders and senior leadership.

  • A uniquely complex business model at the intersection of energy, technology, and finance.

  • Flexible working, 30 vacation days, an L&D budget, competitive compensation, VSOPs (share package), meal vouchers, an Urban Sports membership, and a vibrant Berlin office culture.

Senior Brand Manager - 9 Month FTC
jobs.description:
Senior Brand Manager - 9 Month FTC

About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Brand Team 👋

The Brand team sits at the heart of how Trainline shows up in the world, shaping the perceptions of millions of customers, building lasting brand equity, and ensuring everything we put out is as distinctive and purposeful as the product behind it. We work at the intersection of creative ambition and commercial rigour, delivering campaigns that drive real growth while keeping Trainline front of mind across the UK.

As Interim Senior Brand Manager, you will own the UK brand strategy and lead high-impact integrated campaigns that strengthen brand health and deliver commercial results. Reporting to the Head of Brand & Campaigns, you will be the UK brand custodian, setting creative direction, shaping messaging, and partnering closely with teams across Marketing, Data Science, and Product to ensure our brand shows up consistently and confidently at every stage of the customer journey.

In this role as the Interim Senior Brand Manager, you will...🚄

  • Translate global brand and proposition strategy into locally relevant, growth-driving execution, ensuring our brand platform is embedded consistently across all customer touchpoints.

  • Own the end-to-end development and delivery of integrated campaigns from brief to launch, balancing short-term commercial needs with long-term brand building.

  • Lead and challenge creative agency partners to produce standout, distinctive work, acting as the internal champion for courageous, high-quality creative across every brief, review, and execution.

  • Drive strong go-to-market execution for key product and proposition launches, ensuring cohesive and impactful delivery across all brand touchpoints.

  • Set clear campaign objectives and partner with Data Science and Insights to embed robust measurement, testing, and optimisation from the outset.

  • Own UK brand tracking, translating insight into clear action and continuously improving campaign effectiveness and return on investment.

  • Manage the UK brand budget with strong financial discipline, maintaining high standards across briefing, creative appraisal, and execution governance.

  • Line manage and coach junior members of the team, building a culture of high standards, considered risk-taking, and test-and-learn marketing.

We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍

  • Significant experience in brand marketing within a consumer-facing business, with a proven track record of delivering campaigns that are creatively distinctive and commercially effective.

  • Strong creative judgment, with the ability to recognise genuinely great work and articulate clearly what makes it land.

  • A clear, confident point of view on brand, and the ability to champion that perspective while bringing others on the journey with you.

  • Strong commercial acumen, with a solid understanding of how brand investment translates into measurable business growth.

  • Experience leading and challenging creative agencies to produce their most distinctive and impactful work.

  • A collaborative and influential working style, with the ability to build strong relationships and align stakeholders across teams and at all levels of seniority.

  • Comfort working with data, measurement frameworks, and performance analysis, with the ability to turn insight into clear, actionable decisions.

Head of Marketing

Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

What you'll be doing

The Head of Marketing elevates and differentiates Faculty through a body of opinionated, authoritative AI storytelling, a distinctive brand, and a library of artefacts that bring our teams’ exceptional work and thinking to life - delivered through a marketing plan tightly aligned to Faculty’s business plan and strategic intent.

Key Deliverables

Storytelling & Differentiation

  • Build and scale Faculty’s AI storytelling capability by tapping into the exceptional body of knowledge in the business and shaping it into thoughtful perspectives - anchored in Faculty’s world view on AI and informed by the rapidly evolving AI discourse

  • Own Faculty’s foundational assets: corporate and commercial narratives, sales enablement artefacts, case studies, and canonical presentations - and ensure they are culturally sensitive and travel well

Marketing Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and own the marketing plan, ensuring it is tightly aligned to the business plan and able to flex as priorities shift.

  • Sit as a member of the Marketing Leadership Team, shaping decisions that affect the wider function and bringing a marketing lens to the leadership table.

  • Execute with purpose and precision: every campaign, launch and piece of content should have a clear reason to exist and a clear standard it's held to.

  • Set and protect a language standard that is parsimonious and human: no jargon, no filler, no vague futurism, just clear, confident writing that respects the reader.

Digital, Creative & Content Oversight

  • Oversee digital, creative, events, and content, ensuring every output is intentional, high quality and unmistakably Faculty.

  • Direct creative development across campaigns, visual identity applications, video and design, holding a high bar for craft.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Marketing and Communications Leadership to develop and deliver integrated strategies.

  • Lead, coach and develop a team spanning digital, events, creative and brand disciplines, raising individual capability while staying hands-on where your own judgement adds most value.

  • Bring bold ideas, energy and vision, challenging marketing orthodoxies to bring Faculty marketing to a new level

  • Lead the team to become truly AI-native - using AI tools to work faster and push craft further, as well as identifying opportunities to deploy AI-enabled marketing tools and skills across the business

  • Support the international expansion of Faculty, working with regional colleagues to ensure the Faculty brand travels well and adapts where it needs to.

Who we're looking for

  • Significant experience in the AI space with a proven track record of AI storytelling

  • Proven ability to build and own a marketing strategy for an AI business - grounded in a strong AI storytelling narrative and translated into a coherent brand expression

  • A proven ability to find the story in complex, technical material and tell it with clarity, confidence and a genuine point of view, with an instinct for which formats will make it land.

  • Experience co-creating and owning a marketing plan tightly aligned to business strategy, translating ambition into a deliverable, resourced plan.

  • Experience owning a company's digital channels and platforms and driving brand equity through thoughtful campaigns

  • Comfortable partnering with editorial and content leads to ensure output reinforces positioning and a consistent point of view.

  • Skilled at working alongside C-suite leaders and technical experts, earning trust quickly through sound judgement and a bias for delivery.

  • Proven ability to lead, coach and develop a multi-disciplinary team. A player-coach who neither hides behind the team nor bottlenecks it.

  • Deep understanding of AI, its transformative potential when deployed at enterprise and government scale, its associated risks, and the current landscape of global AI policy and safety discourse.

  • Highly self-sufficient, with the flexibility and tenacity to thrive in a fast-paced, complex scale-up environment now operating at global scale.

Our Interview Process

  • Introduction interview with the Hiring Manager (30 mins)

  • Panel Interview (60 mins)

  • Meet the team (60 mins)

  • Final Stage Interview with the CCO (30 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As our GNC, ML, Embedded Software, and Validation teams scale, they rely increasingly on simulation to develop and test our autonomous defense systems. The value of that simulation depends directly on how faithfully it reproduces the real behavior of our drones.

Joining the Tooling team, you will be responsible for bringing the physical models of our drones into the simulator—including aerodynamics, propulsion, electronics, sensors, and electromechanical systems. Designed by expert domain teams, these models require your expertise to translate user needs, integrate models into the simulator software stack, and validate expected behavior. Because not every use case requires the same level of realism, you will help establish the appropriate fidelity targets across applications.

This role offers high ownership and the opportunity to work at the intersection of physics, software engineering, and AI robotics with direct mission impact.

Responsibilities

  • Coordination with Domain Experts: Work with the teams in charge of aerodynamics, propulsion, electronics, sensors, and electromechanical systems to understand their models, their assumptions, and their inputs and outputs, and to agree on how they are delivered to the simulator.

  • Model Integration: Integrate these models into the simulator software stack in a clean, performant, and maintainable way, with clear interfaces and configurable parameters.

  • Validation: Define and run tests that check the integrated models against the reference data given by the expert teams (flight logs, bench tests, manufacturer data), and report discrepancies back to the model owners.

  • User Needs & Fidelity Targets: Work with the simulator users (GNC, Embedded, Validation) to understand their use cases, and translate them into a realism target for each model. Pick the right balance between fidelity, performance, and integration effort, and prioritise the model integration work to match.

  • Documentation & Standards: Document the integrated models, their parameters, validity domains, and validation results, and help standardise the model integration and validation process.

Candidate requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in software engineering, simulation, or a related engineering field.

  • Physics Understanding: Good understanding of flight dynamics and enough physics background to discuss models with experts in aerodynamics, propulsion, electronics, sensors, and electromechanical systems, and to turn their models into working code.

  • Integration & Validation: Experience integrating third-party models or components into a larger software system, and validating them against experimental data with a rigorous approach.

  • Technical Proficiency: Comfortable with C++ and Python, with a good knowledge of Linux environments.

  • Educational Background: MSc or BSc in Aerospace Engineering, Robotics, Computer Science, Applied Physics, or a similar technical field; equivalent professional experience is equally valued.

Plus (nice to have)

  • Experience with drones or robotic systems, ideally with open-source autopilots like PX4 or ArduPilot.

  • Hands-on experience with flight testing, test benches, or log analysis.

  • French language skills.

Mindset

  • Rigor: Empirical and disciplined about validation, grounded in real test data, and skeptical of a result that only exists in simulation.

  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication, comfortable working with several specialized teams, asking the right questions, and sharing validation results with them.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Vous êtes rattaché(e) au Centre de Recherche et d’Enseignement en Environnement et Risques (CREER) de l'IMT Mines Alès et dans l'unité de recherche : HSM.

Ce travail s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet PREV’IA qui s’intéresse à la connaissance et à la prévision des ressources en eaux de la nappe plioquaternaire de la plaine de Roussillon, et de la source du Lez qui alimente Montpellier en eau potable.

Votre travail s’inscrira dans la continuité d’une thèse en cours au sein de l’UMR HSM (équipe HYTAKE), portant sur la durabilité de la ressource en eau karstique (aquifère du Lez) alimentant une métropole méditerranéenne (Montpellier) en contexte de changement climatique.

 

Votre mission :

  • Utiliser les concepts émergeants dans les approches de « Physics Informed Machine Learning » (PIML) pour évaluer les intérêts d’une synergie en modélisation hydrogéologique : (1) à base conceptuelle d’une part et (2) à base de réseaux de neurones informés, ou complémentés, par la physique. L’approche PIML (Physics Informed Machine Learning) est développée, avec deux courants : (i) les Physics Informed Architecture (PIA) : intégration de connaissances physiques dans l’architecture du modèle (couches cachées) ; et (ii) les Physics Informed Loss Function (PILF) : combinaison de modélisations physiques (équations différentielles) et boîte noire, fusionnées dans la fonction de coût (terme de régularisation). Les deux méthodes pourront être explorées. Les modèles proposés pourront être utilisés pour déterminer l’évolution de certaines grandeurs hydrologiques en réponse au changement climatique.

jobs.description:
Enterprise Account Executive - EMEA

About Abacum

Abacum is the leading Business Planning solution for finance teams to drive performance. By automating reporting, enabling collaboration, and simplifying planning and forecasting, we help finance teams shift from number crunching to driving strategic decisions.

Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities. Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex, and hundreds more.

We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners, with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator, Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.

Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning!

We are looking for...

An enterprise seller who already knows the Office of the CFO. You've carried a number selling planning, EPM, FP&A or finance software. You know how a CFO buys, how a steering committee stalls, and how to get a multi-stakeholder deal signed.

At Abacum you'll own a named territory of enterprise and upper mid-market accounts across EMEA. Many of them run legacy planning tools or spreadsheets that can't keep up with the business. Your job is to show them a better foundation, and win.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will...

- Own the full sales cycle for a named book of enterprise accounts, from first meeting to signed contract

- Build and run your own pipeline through targeted outbound, events, and partner co-selling with ERP vendors and implementation partners

- Sell to CFOs, VPs of Finance and Heads of FP&A, and bring IT, procurement, security and legal along the way

- Run complex evaluations: discovery, business cases, proofs of concept, and competitive displacements

- Forecast with discipline and keep a clean pipeline in CRM

- Work with Solutions Engineering, Product and Leadership to shape deals, and feed what you hear in the market back into the roadmap

What we need...

- 6+ years of quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales, with at least 3 years closing enterprise deals

- Experience selling EPM, FP&A, planning, or other Office-of-the-CFO software (finance, ERP, spend, or data platforms)

- A track record of closing six-figure ARR deals with 3–6 month cycles and hitting or beating quota

- Comfort leading multi-stakeholder deals with finance, IT, procurement and security at the table

- Experience displacing an incumbent, whether a legacy system or a spreadsheet-based process

- A consultative, value-based approach: you build a business case in a CFO's language

- The drive to build your own pipeline, not wait for inbound

- Clear, sharp written and verbal communication, including running demos with senior buyers

- Based in EMEA, with the ability to travel to customers and events

Bonus points if you have...

- Sold with or through ERP ecosystems (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics) or implementation partners

- Worked in finance, or you're comfortable talking models, drivers and variances with an FP&A team

- Used a structured sales method (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or similar)

- Been an early seller at a scaling company and helped build the enterprise playbook

Why sell Abacum

You know the category. Here's why this is the product you want in your bag.

1. A market ready to switch. Finance teams are stuck between rigid legacy planning tools that need a rebuild every time the business changes, and spreadsheets and AI tools no one can trust. Abacum is the governed, AI-native foundation that fixes both. That's a displacement story you can tell in every account.

2. AI that stands up to a CFO. Plenty of vendors claim AI. Ours runs on a governed financial model, so the AI reasons and the math stays exact. CFOs and IT teams can trust the output, and that wins technical evaluations.

3. Faster time to value than legacy EPM. 700+ integrations and self-service data pipelines mean customers see value in weeks, not after a long implementation. That shortens your cycle and makes the business case easy to sign.

4. Channels that bring you deals. Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description:
Technical Support Engineer

Quicknode is a cloud-based infrastructure company that powers the blockchain ecosystem.

Our mission is to be the indispensable utility that empowers companies and innovators globally to build next-generation, Web3 enabled businesses & applications using blockchain technology. Quicknode is backed by some of the world's best investors including Tiger Global, Y Combinator, SoftBank, and the Seven Seven Six Fund. The Quicknode team has over 110 people maintaining high performance global data infrastructure for amazing customers serving billions of requests daily.

We are a global remote company with offices in Fort Lauderdale, FL and Lisbon, Portugal.

The Role

As a Technical Support Engineer, you will be working on everything from answering simple support requests from potential customers about our service to setting up a local proxy to debug outgoing Web3 requests. You will be responsible for ensuring that we provide resolutions to customers quickly and, when that is not possible, translating customer hardships into actionable items for our developer team to fix. Our network services more than 10 billion requests per month, so you will be crucial in debugging the core issues customers experience with custom software, off-the-shelf tooling, and more. You won’t be alone because we expect every Engineer to spend time on customer support, on a rotating basis, to understand our customers better.

We’re looking for a self-starter who is communication-focused, with a deep sense of ownership and a team mentality, to collaborate on achieving a high-quality customer experience. We’re looking for an individual who does not need constant supervision to track and reproduce customer issues. You can expect to meet daily to review customer issues, task progress, and solution design.

What You'll Do

  • Own and resolve technical support requests from customers, ranging from basic product questions to complex Web3, infrastructure, and integration issues.

  • Triage, reproduce, and debug customer-reported issues using logs, CLI tools, scripting, local proxies, and other troubleshooting methods.

  • Clearly document technical findings, reproduction steps, customer impact, and recommended next actions for Engineering, Infra, Product, and TechOps teams.

  • Translate recurring customer issues into actionable improvements, including bug reports, product feedback, internal tooling needs, and support process updates.

  • Partner closely with Engineering and other cross-functional teams to ensure customer issues are resolved quickly and escalations are handled with urgency and context.

  • Create and maintain internal support documentation, runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and customer-facing resources to improve support quality and consistency.

  • Build or improve scripts, tooling, and automation that reduce manual support effort and improve time to resolution.

  • Manage customer account and billing-related support needs, including refunds, credits, and charges in Stripe when appropriate.

  • Participate in daily support reviews, team handoffs, and support rotations to ensure strong customer coverage and shared visibility into active issues.

  • Help maintain a high-quality customer experience by communicating clearly, taking ownership, and following issues through to resolution.

What You'll Bring

  • 1+ years of experience in a technical support role.

  • 1+ year of experience in Blockchain, or equivalent personal project experience.

  • Advanced scripting in more than one of the following languages: Python, Go, Ruby, or Bash.

  • Knowledge of core internet protocols, including DNS, TCP/SSL, and HTTP.

  • Familiarity with the Ethereum JSON-RPC specification.

  • Experience maintaining infrastructure as code using Terraform and preferably Ansible; experience with Salt, Puppet, or Chef is also acceptable.

  • Expertise in managing Linux hosts.

  • Experience with proactive alerting and monitoring technologies.

  • Experience providing technical customer support using troubleshooting methods, CLI tools, and Linux.

  • Ability to set up software that may be unfamiliar.

  • Thoroughness in debugging and documenting issues for other teams.

  • Ability to proactively solve complex problems before they affect multiple customers.

  • A habit of documenting processes and sharing knowledge.

The Quicknode compensation philosophy includes pillars to ensure fair and unbiased compensation for all employees. To design and deliver total reward offerings that are employee-centric. To offer a competitive benefit package in all locations where we operate. To prioritize attracting and retaining the best talent globally. To maintain a high-performing and flexible way of working.

During the hiring process, we are committed to discussing compensation openly and honestly. We encourage candidates to share their salary expectations and requirements early, allowing for an individualized discussion. We know that our total rewards practices impact the lives and wellbeing of our employees. Therefore, we will never stop learning about the market, our business, your needs, and how best to achieve our goals through thoughtful and data-driven practices. If you have any questions or require further information about the compensation for this position, please don't hesitate to reach out to your Recruiter.

We at Quicknode are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
