jobs.description:
AI Solutions & Process Engineer

AI Solutions & Process Engineer

Festanstellung, Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ)

Deine Mission

Die Energiekosten in Europa sind doppelt so hoch wie in den USA und China. Gleichzeitig wird sich die Stromnachfrage bis 2050 voraussichtlich verdoppeln. Marktpreisvolatilität und zunehmende Komplexität werden uns erhalten bleiben. Damit steht das Rückgrat der europäischen Industrie unter Druck – und Unternehmen müssen jetzt handeln.

trawa entwickelt die Lösung: die erste integrierte B2B-Energieplattform, die Energiebeschaffung, Energiemanagement und die Steuerung von Flexibilitäten in einem Produkt vereint. Supply, Manage, Flex – kombiniert. Diese Integration ermöglicht Einsparungen von bis zu 30 % bei den wiederkehrenden Stromkosten und unterstützt Unternehmen gleichzeitig dabei, auf erneuerbare Energien umzusteigen.

Wir sind Europas am schnellsten wachsende B2B-Energieplattform. Aktuell sind wir in Deutschland und Österreich aktiv und planen, unsere Aktivitäten 2027 auf einen dritten Markt auszuweiten. Unser Ziel ist die europaweite Skalierung. Wir bewegen uns schnell – das Marktfenster ist offen, und wir wollen es nutzen.

Über trawa

trawa ist ein Scale-up mit Sitz in Berlin und rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, davon etwa 30 in Product & Tech. Bis heute haben wir mehr als 35 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, darunter eine Series-A-Finanzierungsrunde über 24 Millionen Euro im Mai 2025. Zu unseren Investoren zählen Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic und Tiny VC. Alle drei Gründer sind weiterhin aktiv dabei und zu 100 % committed, das Energieversorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft aufzubauen.

Wir suchen eine:n AI Solutions & Process Engineer, um gemeinsam die nächste Wachstumsstufe zu erreichen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren General Manager Energy Solutions und arbeitest eng mit unseren Tech- & Commercial-Teams zusammen. Du gestaltest das Produkt mit, das die europäische Industrie wieder wettbewerbsfähiger macht – und setzt deine Ideen mit hohem Tempo um.

Die Position ist in Berlin angesiedelt. trawa ist ein Office-First-Unternehmen: In der Regel arbeitest du an fünf Tagen pro Woche aus unserem Büro.

Wen wir suchen

  • Digital Experience: Du entwickelst sowohl customer-facing als auch interne Tools entlang der User Journey, die uns im europäischem Energiemarkt einen strukturellen Wettbewerbsvorteil verschaffen. Dabei eliminierst du Friction, erhöhst Conversion Rates und schaffst so die Grundlage für skalierbares Wachstum.

  • Scalability: Du verantwortest die übergreifende Prozessarchitektur inkl. Datenmodell des Revenue-Prozesses, identifizierst gemeinsam mit den betroffenen Teams kontinuierlich Optimierungspotenzial und steigerst durch Automatisierung nachhaltig die Effizienz unserer Prozesse.

  • Growth Engine: Du vereinst unsere interne Prozessarchitektur mit der digitalen Experience und schaffst so eine Growth Engine, die nachhaltiges, planbares und skalierbares Wachstum für trawa schafft.

  • User Journey: Du hast die Journey unserer Kunden und die dahinterliegenden Prozesse ganzheitlich im Blick – vom Erstkontakt mit einem Lead bis zum erfolgreichen Start einer Kundenbeziehung - gleichermaßen aus Kundenperspektive wie auch aus interner Sicht rund um operative Skalierbarkeit.

  • AI Craftsmanship: Du nutzt state-of-the art AI Lösungen in deiner täglichen Arbeit und baust so AI-native Lösungen, die trawa als Vorreiter im Energiemarkt rund um den Einsatz von AI positionieren.

Deine Ziele in den ersten 90 Tagen

  • Du hast das notwendige Verständnis zu unseren Produkten, zum Energiemarkt, zur Journey unserer Kunden sowie zu relevanten internen Prozessen aufgebaut.

  • Du hast dich als fester Ansprechpartner rund um unsere Growth Engine etabliert - und bist im stetigen Austausch mit allen wichtigen internen Stakeholdern dazu.

  • Du hast eine Strategie für die Weiterentwicklung des Bereichs bei trawa entwickelt, klare Prioritäten gesetzt und eine Roadmap mit klaren Verantwortlichkeiten und Meilensteinen aufgesetzt, die unser weiteres Wachstum in Deutschland und die Expansion unterstützt.

  • Du hast dabei insbesondere erste Optimierungsprojekte zur Steigerung der Conversion Rates sowie zur internen Prozessoptimierung angestoßen - und erste Ergebnisse sind in Sicht.

Was dir zum Erfolg verhilft

  • Du kannst technische Lösungen nicht nur mit Low-Code- oder Vibe-Coding-Ansätzen umsetzen, sondern bist auch in der Lage, robusten Code zu entwickeln – oder bist motiviert, dich in diesem Bereich weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Du verbindest technisches Denken mit Nutzerverständnis. Mithilfe qualitativer und quantitativer Research-Methoden identifizierst du Pain Points, validierst Hypothesen und leitest daraus Lösungen mit echtem Mehrwert für die User ab.

  • Du gehst Aufgaben mit Eigeninitiative und klarer Zielorientierung an.

  • Du denkst analytisch und strukturiert: Komplexe Prozesse zerlegst du gerne in einzelne Schritte, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlen und Metriken.

  • Du berücksichtigst bei deiner Entscheidungsfindung auch strategische Ziele und kannst dich sowohl in die Perspektive von Kunden als auch von unserem Vertrieb hineinversetzen.

  • Du bist am Puls der Zeit rund um AI: Du verfolgst aktuelle AI-Trends, testest neue Tools und entwickelst deine Expertise stetig weiter.

  • Du überzeugst durch starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und eine kooperative Arbeitsweise. Der Austausch mit internen Stakeholdern fällt dir ebenso leicht wie die professionelle Kommunikation mit Kund:innen und externen Ansprechpartner.

  • Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

Warum trawa?

Wirkung: Europäische KMU geben jährlich zwischen 150.000 und 10 Millionen Euro für Strom aus – viele davon zahlen zu viel und sind an veraltete Beschaffungsmodelle gebunden. Mit unserem Produkt veränderst du unmittelbar, wie Tausende Unternehmen Energie einkaufen, managen und nutzen. Die Wirkung ist messbar, der Markt ist riesig und der Zeitpunkt ist jetzt.

Verantwortung: Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung für deine Themen und treibst Ergebnisse voran – unabhängig von deinem Hintergrund oder deiner bisherigen Berufserfahrung.

Lernen und Entwicklung: Wir stellen dir ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget und feste Zeit für deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung zur Verfügung. Dich erwarten Mentoring, vielfältige Lernmöglichkeiten und echte Perspektiven für deinen nächsten Karriereschritt.

Vielfalt und Inklusion: Wir sind ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit lebt, und unser Team spiegelt das wider. Menschen aus mehr als 15 Nationen bringen unterschiedliche Sprachen, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven zusammen. Bei trawa ist Familienfreundlichkeit auf allen Ebenen selbstverständlich – in unserem Team und in der Führung arbeiten Eltern. Wir setzen uns für ein inklusives Umfeld ein, in dem alle ihr Bestes geben können.

Vergütung und Benefits: Wir bieten ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket mit Gehalt und Stock Options, 30 Urlaubstagen sowie zahlreichen Benefits. Dazu gehören Zuschüsse für Internet und Mittagessen, eine Mitgliedschaft im Sport Club, feste Lerntage mit jährlichem Weiterbildungsbudget, ein wöchentliches Team-Mittagessen und regelmäßige Teamevents.

Bei trawa bauen wir einen vielfältigen, inklusiven und authentischen Arbeitsplatz auf. Wenn dich die Position begeistert, dein bisheriger Weg aber nicht in allen Punkten dem Anforderungsprofil entspricht, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Vielleicht bist du genau die richtige Person für diese oder eine andere Position bei uns.

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive - Telecommunications (F/H)
jobs.description:
Senior Account Executive - Telecommunications (F/H)

The Mission: Strategic Growth & Deep-Tech Advisory (Telecom Focus)

At Illuin Technology, we don't just "sell" software; we architect the AI future of the world’s largest organizations. As a Senior Account Executive specialized in Telecommunications, your mission is to manage a strategic portfolio of 5 to 10 major enterprise accounts within the Telco sector. You aren't just a vendor; you are a trusted advisor navigating high-stakes environments to deliver durable, multi-year partnerships with Tier-1 operators, ISPs, and infrastructure providers.

You will master a dual-track revenue model: driving multi-year licenses for our cutting-edge AI product suite while orchestrating high-impact strategic consulting projects. Your success is measured by your ability to penetrate complex telecom organizations, build C-Level intimacy, and turn technical excellence into sustainable commercial success.

Your DNA

  • The Telco Strategic Hunter: You thrive in the complexity of long sales cycles (6–12 months) specific to the telecommunications industry. You don't just wait for leads; you build account plans that map out stakeholders and influence the RFP (Appel d'Offres) before it’s even written. You have successfully answered and won major Telco RFPs in the past.

  • Industry Insider: You possess a profound understanding of the Telco landscape. You know the specific challenges of the sector—from 5G monetization and network optimization to OSS/BSS modernization and customer churn reduction—and you know how to leverage AI to address them.

  • Hybrid Commercial Profile: You are equally at home selling scalable SaaS products as you are selling high-value, bespoke strategic services (Time & Materials (T&M) and Fixed-price).

  • AI Fluent: You possess a deep cognitive curiosity for AI and IT architecture. You can hold your own in a room of Telco CTOs, CIOs, and Data Leads, translating technical capabilities into tangible business ROI.

  • The "Field" Mentality: You believe sales happen in the room, not just on Zoom. You enjoy being on the field, building relationships in person, and mastering the nuances of the Paris business ecosystem.

  • Force Multiplier: You make the team better—sharing best practices, supporting peers, and stepping in when needed. Your presence increases the effectiveness and cohesion of the entire group and helps more junior team members.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Account Orchestration: Take full ownership of a targeted portfolio. You will define the strategy to expand our footprint exclusively within the Telecommunications sector.

  • Complex RFP Management: Lead and coordinate responses to highly complex, multi-million-euro Telco RFPs. You will mobilize internal resources to craft winning proposals tailored to operators' stringent requirements.

  • Full-Cycle Execution: From cold-start qualification (MEDDIC/BANT) to complex negotiations and closing. You’ll be expertly managing all stages of the sales process.

  • C-Suite Advisory: Act as the primary point of contact for C-Level as well as B-Level stakeholders in Telco organizations, identifying pain points and aligning them with Illuin’s AI roadmap.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with our Pre-sales, Products, and Engineering teams to ensure that the "vision" sold is technically sound and perfectly delivered.

  • Pipeline Rigor: Maintain extreme discipline in your CRM and forecasting. You understand that "hope is not a strategy" and rely on data to drive your activity.

Profile Requirements

  • Track Record & RFP Mastery: 10+ years of experience in consultative sales for Large Enterprise accounts, with a mandatory, verifiable track record of responding to and winning large-scale Telco RFPs. (Be prepared to provide concrete examples/track record during the process).

  • Deep Vertical Expertise: Exceptional knowledge and an active, existing network within the Telecommunications industry. You speak the language of Telco operators flawlessly.

  • Background: Ideally coming from a high-growth Scale-Up, a specialized Telco software vendor, or a Tier-1 Digital Transformation consultancy.

  • Technical Acumen: Strong understanding of Software/SaaS models and a genuine interest in Generative AI and Data ecosystems.

  • Methodology: Mastery of enterprise sales frameworks (MEDDIC, Challenger Sale, or similar).

  • Cognitive Ability: You are comfortable with numbers, mental math for on-the-spot business cases, and complex problem-solving.

  • Languages: Native-level French and professional fluency in English.

  • Logistics: Comfortable working from our HQ in La Défense (Paris) with a 1-day-per-week remote policy.

Why Join Us ?

  • Unrivaled Tech Stack: Sell the most advanced AI solutions in the market—products that are actually in production, not just "PowerPoint AI."

  • High Stakes, High Reward: Manage 5-10 accounts where your impact is visible and your commission is uncapped based on performance.

  • Culture of Excellence: Join a team of "Doers" where the Sales function is central to the company’s trajectory.

  • Prestige & Growth: Work at the intersection of a top-tier consultancy and a disruptive software editor.

The Selection Process

  • Talent Screen: A 30-minute screening focusing on your enterprise track record, Telco experience, and sales methodology.

  • The Deep Dive: Interview with the Head of Sales/Founders to discuss your past quotas, your specific Telco "war stories," and your RFP track record.

  • Sales Case Study: A simulated account planning and pitch session to demonstrate your consultative approach and "number crunching" skills on a realistic Telco scenario.

  • Cultural Alignment: A final round to meet the wider team and ensure a shared "challenger" mindset.

Senior Business Development Manager - Dissemination & Distribution

Are you a driven sales professional with deep expertise in fund data and a passion for opening doors across French-speaking Europe?

This is a rare opportunity to take full ownership of a high-growth territory, shaping the go-to-market strategy for FE fundinfo's Dissemination & Distribution solutions across France, Belgium, Luxembourg and French-speaking Switzerland. You will work at the intersection of sales leadership, product influence and market development - engaging senior stakeholders at asset managers, private banks, platforms and data vendors to deliver real impact.

Hybrid working is supported where applicable. Cross-border working arrangements must comply with local regulations (Luxembourg).

Your key responsibilities as a Senior Business Development Manager will include:

  • Owning and executing the sales strategy for FE fundinfo's Dissemination and Distribution solutions across asset managers in French-speaking Europe.
  • Driving pipeline, bookings and territory growth through programmatic execution of the go-to-market plan across France, Belgium, Luxembourg and French-speaking Switzerland.
  • Positioning FE fundinfo's Dissemination solutions to help clients distribute fund data, factsheets and regulatory documents to platforms, distributors and data vendors.
  • Generating demand in collaboration with marketing and a dedicated BDR team, representing FE fundinfo at industry events across the territory.
  • Partnering with Client Success and Product teams to deliver a seamless post-sales experience and bring the voice of the customer into the roadmap.
  • Developing deep expertise in fund data distribution trends across French-speaking European markets, building relationships with asset managers and distribution teams.

You will need the following experience and skills to join us as a Senior Business Development Manager:

  • You have a strong track record in SaaS technology or data sales, with mandatory experience selling into the Asset Management sector.
  • You are fluent in both English and French at C1 level, with strong written and verbal communication skills in each language.

At FE fundinfo, you will join a collaborative, intellectually curious team that genuinely invests in its people. jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
jobs.description:
Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
Description

Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes.

You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind.


Your mission

1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence 

  • Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution.

  • Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy.

  • Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters.

  • Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo.

2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership 

  • Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer.

  • Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders).

  • Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice.

  • Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos.

3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement 

  • Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation.

  • Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations.

  • Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder.

What We Want to Achieve Together

In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds.

In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount.


Your profile

  • Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies.

  • Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences.

  • Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility.

  • Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data.

  • AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new.

  • A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough.

  • Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both.


Why us?

  • Real editorial ownership over our voice and our position, not a content calendar handed down from someone else.

  • A platform to build your own visible profile as a voice in Legal AI.

  • Modern office in Leipzig or Berlin, hybrid setup, with regular presence in Zürich and team events such as hiking, dinners and offsites.

  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) participation.

  • Competitive salary, based on experience and seniority.


Process

  1. 30 min with our People & Operations Manager: cultural fit, understanding the role and your expectations.

  2. Positioning conversation with our Head of Product: bring a point of view on Legal AI and be ready to defend it live.

  3. Case study: show us something you’ve written or built, and how you’d turn it into a sales-ready asset.

  4. Meet the team in the office.

  5. Decision: if it’s mutual, we welcome you to the team!

How to Apply

Send us your CV, two or three writing or work samples you’re proud of, and a short note answering: what’s your sharpest point of view on where Legal AI is heading, and what’s the evidence?

jobs.title: Senior Supplier Quality Development Specialist
jobs.description:
Senior Supplier Quality Development Specialist
Join Our Team

We are the Audi Revolut F1® Team.
Audi Revolut F1 Team is the official factory team of Audi, as the brand enters the FIA Formula 1 World Championship for the first time in 2026. 
The team is based in three locations: the power unit is developed by Audi Formula Racing GmbH at the Audi Competence Center Motorsport in Neuburg, Germany; the chassis is engineered and race operations are managed from the state-of-the-art facilities of Audi Motorsport AG in Hinwil, Switzerland; while the Audi Motorsport Technology Centre UK in Bicester, United Kingdom, provides a foothold in the heart of 'Motorsport Valley', with direct access to top F1 talent and key strategic partners.
What you need? The mindset of an athlete. If you are someone for whom giving up isn’t an option and limits are just something to be overcome, you can bring Vorsprung durch Technik to Formula 1 with us. Become part of this unique project and make motorsport history.
 
This position for the Audi Revolut F1® Team is based at Audi Motorsport AG in Hinwil (Switzerland).


Your mission

  • Active supplier development to ensure high quality standards
  • Establishment of a stable network with key suppliers
  • Supplier audits based on defined standards
  • Quality agreements with suppliers
  • Identification of opportunities for optimisation in supplier processes and implementation of appropriate measures
  • Monitoring of supplier performance (KPIs: on-time delivery, lead time, defect rate, corrective actions/NCRs)
  • Measurable improvement in supplier quality through targeted corrective actions
  • Support for problem-solving, root cause analysis and corrective measures (PDCA)
  • Analysis of quality data and preparation of reports on supplier performance
  • Close communication with internal stakeholders and external partners to prevent defects


Your profile

  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Mechanical Engineering or a related field
  • Successful completion of auditor training would be an advantage
  • Substantial professional experience as a quality specialist in the field of supplier quality
  • Proficiency in using data analysis tools, particularly Power BI
  • Strong assertiveness and a highly solution-oriented approach
  • Good interpersonal skills and the ability to network effectively
  • Confident manner when dealing with external partners and stakeholders
  • Willingness to travel 40–50 per cent of the time to work on-site at suppliers’ premises is required
  • Fluent in English and German

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Go & Rust, Blockchain Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer - Go & Rust, Blockchain Infrastructure

Quicknode is a cloud-based infrastructure company that powers the blockchain ecosystem.

Our mission is to be the indispensable utility that empowers companies and innovators globally to build next-generation, Web3 enabled businesses & applications using blockchain technology. Quicknode is backed by some of the world's best investors including Tiger Global, Y Combinator, SoftBank, and the Seven Seven Six Fund. The Quicknode team has over 110 people maintaining high performance global data infrastructure for amazing customers serving billions of requests daily.

We are a global remote company with offices in Fort Lauderdale, FL and Lisbon, Portugal.

The Role

Quicknode deploys institutional-grade infrastructure - Core RPC API, Streams, Webhooks, Clusters, and developer tooling - across 80+ blockchain networks for teams building onchain. The Engineering team behind this infrastructure needs a senior individual contributor who can design, build, and improve the distributed systems that ingest, process, and serve blockchain data at scale, working across both Go and Rust.

This is a hands-on engineering and technical-leadership role for someone who moves comfortably between high-throughput Go services and performance- and security-critical Rust components. You will own complex systems from design through production and raise the engineering bar on reliability, performance, security, and operational quality.

This role reports into Engineering leadership for the Blockchain Infrastructure team and carries no direct reports at this level. As scope grows, you will take on larger system ownership, mentor other engineers, and help set engineering standards adopted across teams - a natural path toward Staff or Principal Engineer.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and optimize high-throughput, low-latency backend services, APIs, and data-processing systems in both Go and Rust for production blockchain infrastructure.

  • Own production Go services and Rust components, including their architecture, interfaces, concurrency models, memory and resource efficiency, testing, observability, deployment, and operation.

  • Architect distributed systems that ingest, process, validate, and serve blockchain data with strong guarantees around consistency, fault tolerance, scalability, and availability.

  • Own technical work end to end, including requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, observability, incident response, and continuous improvement.

  • Profile and benchmark production systems, identify bottlenecks, and improve throughput, latency, resource efficiency, resilience, and correctness under load.

  • Assess security risks in blockchain and distributed-system components and design or review controls that protect transactions, data, credentials, and system integrity.

  • Debug complex failures across services, databases, streaming systems, networks, and blockchain nodes, then drive durable root-cause fixes.

  • Partner with Product, Infrastructure, Security, and Developer Experience teams to translate customer and protocol requirements into maintainable systems.

  • Lead design and code reviews, mentor engineers, document important decisions, and establish engineering standards that improve quality across teams.

What You'll Bring

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial experience building and operating backend or distributed systems in high-scale production environments.

  • Advanced professional proficiency in both Go and Rust, with demonstrated experience shipping and operating production software in each language. Go and Rust are both core requirements for this role, not interchangeable alternatives.

  • Deep knowledge of distributed systems, algorithms and data structures, concurrency, memory safety and ownership, databases, networking, operating systems, and production software architecture.

  • A record of delivering reliable, scalable systems with measurable improvements in performance, availability, correctness, or developer experience.

  • Experience with blockchain infrastructure, high-throughput APIs, node or RPC infrastructure, data-streaming pipelines, or similarly demanding distributed platforms.

  • Experience applying secure-design principles, threat modeling, and disciplined testing to systems where correctness and availability are critical.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, sound technical judgment, and the ability to lead ambiguous, cross-team projects without constant direction.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Ethereum, Solana, or other major blockchain protocols and their node, RPC, indexing, or transaction-processing architecture.

  • Experience designing clean interfaces between Go services and Rust systems, libraries, or performance-sensitive components.

  • Experience designing or reviewing cryptographic, wallet, signing, custody, or other security-sensitive systems.

  • Experience with streaming and data infrastructure such as Kafka, queues, event-driven services, distributed databases, or large-scale observability systems.

  • Demonstrated technical leadership through architecture ownership, mentorship, incident leadership, or engineering standards adopted by multiple teams.

The Quicknode compensation philosophy includes pillars to ensure fair and unbiased compensation for all employees. To design and deliver total reward offerings that are employee-centric. To offer a competitive benefit package in all locations where we operate. To prioritize attracting and retaining the best talent globally. To maintain a high-performing and flexible way of working.

During the hiring process, we are committed to discussing compensation openly and honestly. We encourage candidates to share their salary expectations and requirements early, allowing for an individualized discussion. We know that our total rewards practices impact the lives and wellbeing of our employees. Therefore, we will never stop learning about the market, our business, your needs, and how best to achieve our goals through thoughtful and data-driven practices. If you have any questions or require further information about the compensation for this position, please don't hesitate to reach out to your Recruiter.

Senior QA Engineer

Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production.

Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first.

We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien!

The Mission

This role is a Senior QA/Test Engineer specializing in Amazon Connect and contact center technology, responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies across contact flows, routing, IVR/self-service, and AI-driven conversational agents. They validate legacy-to-Connect migrations, build and maintain manual and automated test suites (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium) spanning UI, API, and serverless backend components, and ensure production readiness through cutover validation, monitoring verification, and incident triage. Beyond hands-on testing, they partner with engineers to shift quality left, run UAT sessions with customer stakeholders, and contribute reusable test assets and mentorship to strengthen Caylent's contact center QA practice.

Your Assignment

Test Strategy & Contact Center Quality

  • Design and execute test strategies for Amazon Connect implementations covering contact flows, routing logic, IVR/self-service, Cases/Tasks workflows, and Contact Lens configurations
  • Build test plans that validate AI agent behavior: intent recognition accuracy, escalation paths, barge-in/fallback handling, hallucination guardrails, and multilingual/SSML voice interactions
  • Validate legacy-to-Connect migrations (i.e. Avaya, Genesys, Connect, NICE) through parallel-run testing, flow conversion verification, and data migration validation
  • Define and track quality metrics (defect density, test coverage, escape rate) and report on release readiness to delivery leads and customer stakeholders

Manual, Automated & Full-Stack Testing

  • Build and maintain manual and automated test suites: Playwright E2E and API tests, Cypress, Selenium, integration tests against live Amazon Connect instances, and end-to-end tests of Amazon connect call flows.
  • Test custom Agent Workspace experiences (Amazon Connect, Agent Assist)
  • Validate serverless, event-driven backends (Lambda, EventBridge, Step Functions, SQS/SNS, DynamoDB, Kinesis) with integration and contract tests

Production Readiness & Operations

  • Execute phased rollout and cutover validation for live contact centers, where testing gaps translate directly into missed calls and customer impact
  • Verify monitoring and alerting coverage (CloudWatch metrics, alarms, dashboards) across voice, chat, tasks, queues, agents, Lambda, and AI agents prior to go-live
  • Participate in production incident triage, reproducing defects and validating fixes across the contact center stack

Collaboration & Practice Contribution

  • Proficiency with automated testing frameworks (Playwright E2E and API tests, Cypress, Selenium) for unit, integration, and E2E testing
  • Experience testing serverless/event-driven AWS architectures (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Step Functions)

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) and integrating automated tests into deployment workflow

jobs.title: Email Automation & QA Specialist
jobs.description:
Email Automation & QA Specialist

Who We Are

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com, H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

About the role

Imprint's Marketing Design team builds and maintains the design systems behind a growing portfolio of partner brands — across email, web, in-app, paid, and print. Email is at the center of how we communicate with cardholders, and doing it well at scale requires both a reliable production engine and a high-quality validation layer.

We’re looking for an Email Automation & QA Specialist who thrives at the intersection of content, systems, code, and quality. You’ll be the person who:

  • Understands how emails are designed, assembled, personalized, and launched in Braze (templates, catalogs, content blocks, Liquid, localization, and tracking).

  • Builds AI automations to accelerate and standardize production.

  • Introduces an AI QA layer that flags issues early (before human review), and owns the final human QA process and quality bar.

This is a systems-and-quality role: you’ll improve and maintain our automation and QA workflows so production stays reliable as we scale.

What you’ll own

Content catalog management & template assembly (Braze)

  • Assemble new email templates from already-developed components in Braze, ensuring the final output matches the original Figma source and approved copy.

  • Build, update, and maintain reusable content blocks and catalog entries across our partner programs.

  • Manage content accuracy, localization, and versioning across a growing library of partner templates.

  • Partner with the design technologist to flag structural/component issues and improve the underlying system.

  • Build and iterate on AI-assisted workflows that convert Figma designs + copy into the content structures we use to power reusable, dynamic templates in Braze.

AI-first QA → human QA (quality pipeline)

  • Design and implement an AI QA checklist that runs before human review (e.g., link/UTM validation, Liquid variable presence, localization completeness, dark mode considerations, compliance string presence, etc.).

  • Maintain QA tooling outputs (logs, check reports, tracked issues) so QA is repeatable and measurable.

  • Conduct end-to-end human QA on every email before it reaches the lifecycle team — proofreading, link validation, rendering checks across clients and dark mode, and dynamic content verification.

  • Run inbox testing and document/resolve issues prior to deployment; continually improve the checklist based on issues found.

  • Create lightweight tools/scripts/prompts that standardize repetitive tasks and improve QA quality.

  • Own documentation, versioning, and ongoing maintenance of automations as components, partner programs, and requirements evolve.

Braze campaign & canvas support

  • Support Marketing Ops/Lifecycle with campaign and canvas builds by providing ready content catalogs and thoroughly validated templates in Braze.

  • Manage content setup, dynamic content logic, and final QA to ensure accurate and timely launches.

  • Maintain and update existing campaigns as partner programs evolve — offer swaps, compliance edits, copy updates — with automation where possible and careful review always.

Link tracking, and validation

  • Generate, manage, and QA campaign links ensuring all UTM tracking is accurate and functioning correctly.

  • Work with Branch.io or similar deep linking platforms to set up and validate deep links.

  • Build automated checks to catch common tracking issues before launch (broken links, missing UTMs, wrong destinations, mismatched deep links).

Code troubleshooting & safe updates

  • Troubleshoot and make updates to HTML and Liquid code within existing email templates (within established patterns and guardrails).

  • Maintain a working knowledge of email client rendering and compatibility best practices.

  • When automation or templates hit a complexity wall, escalate appropriately — and propose systemic fixes to reduce repeats.

What we’re looking for

Essential

  • Strong systems thinking and attention to detail — you catch edge cases and take pride in error-free output.

  • Practical experience building or operating automation (AI-assisted workflows, scripts, no-code/low-code tools, or process automation) in a production environment.

  • Working knowledge of HTML and CSS for email — enough to troubleshoot, update, and QA code confidently.

  • Experience with Liquid templating or similar dynamic content systems.

  • Deep familiarity with how work moves through a production pipeline: inputs → assembly → validation → launch → iteration.

  • Comfort with tooling and operational rigor: naming conventions, documentation, change control, and ongoing maintenance.

  • Clear, proactive communication and ownership of deliverables.

Preferred

  • Experience with Braze or a comparable lifecycle marketing platform.

  • Experience with content catalog management and dynamic template logic.

  • Familiarity with UTM tracking, link management, and campaign attribution.

  • Experience with mobile deep linking platforms (e.g., Branch.io).

  • Experience with inbox testing tools and client rendering QA.

  • Experience working within a component-based design system.

How this role fits the team

This role sits within the design technology pillar of the Marketing Design team, working closely with the design technologist, content strategist, and senior designers — and partnering with Lifecycle/Marketing Ops for launches.

You’ll receive finished designs and copy, build them accurately into Braze, and hand off validated campaigns to lifecycle managers. Your lane is automation + execution quality: improving how we produce emails, ensuring the system keeps working as we scale, and maintaining a consistent quality bar across every partner send.

Senior Pricing Data Scientist

From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

This is a unique role that sits at the intersection of economics, analytics, product, and strategy. You’ll combine rigorous quantitative analysis with customer research and commercial thinking to shape how Fivetran prices, packages, and monetizes its products.

What You’ll Do

  • Analyze product usage, deal, financial, and billing data to model pricing, packaging, and monetization scenarios.
  • Design frameworks to assess willingness to pay, customer value, and price realization across customer segments and product lines.
  • Conduct research on pricing strategies, packaging models, and monetization approaches across comparable and adjacent markets.
  • Lead pricing and packaging strategy for new product launches, partnering with Product, GTM, and Finance to define commercial models
  • Build value-based pricing and econometric models to quantify elasticity, customer ROI, and lifetime value.
  • Design and execute pricing experiments
  • Synthesize quantitative analysis, customer research, and competitive intelligence into executive recommendations that influence pricing strategy.
  • Drive customer and prospect research to understand purchasing behavior, value perception, and pricing friction.
  • Partner closely with Product, Analytics, Finance, Sales, Marketing, and Legal to deliver end-to-end pricing initiatives.
  • Define KPIs and dashboards that measure pricing performance and identify optimization opportunities.
  • Continuously evolve our pricing and packaging strategy to improve ARR growth, customer adoption, and value realization.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • 5–8 years designing or operating SaaS or sophisticated B2C pricing models, preferably with usage‑based or behavioral pricing experience
  • Deep quantitative chops—an advanced degree (PhD/MSc) in Economics, Statistics, Operations Research, Applied Math, or similar
  • Fluency in SQL and Python for large‑scale data analysis; proficiency with BI tools such as Looker or Tableau; bonus for dbt
  • Hands‑on experience with conjoint, MaxDiff, Gabor-Granger, or Van Westendorp surveys and causal experiment design
  • Strong attention to detail and data analysis skills – including interpreting results and recommending actions
  • Proven record of turning complex models and analyses into recommendations and shipping changes that moved ARR, gross margin, or NRR
  • Collaborative mindset with Product, Analytics, Finance, Sales, and Legal; you can navigate from whiteboard to contract terms with ease
  • Strong communication and presentation skills with ability to influence at the executive level

You’ll act as the project manager, consultant, and change management coach, ensuring customers achieve rapid time-to-value and long-term success on the Karbon platform.

jobs.description:
AWS DevOps Engineer (Freelancer)

Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract.

This freelance role sits in our infrastructure modernization work under the Application & Database Modernization pillar: moving legacy infrastructure and large enterprise workloads to AWS, and making the resulting platforms boring to operate. Customers come to us with hand-built environments, release cycles that depend on heroics, and big data workloads that outgrew their monitoring years ago.

You'll work as a hands-on DevOps engineer on customer deployments, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, automated monitoring — for enterprise applications, customer applications, and big data workloads. Aedeon absorbs the discovery and validation grind; your billed hours go to the automation and reliability engineering that gets releases out and keeps them out. It's client-facing work: you set customer expectations and then meet them.

What you will do?

  • Automate infrastructure creation using Terraform and AWS CloudFormation.
  • Run application configuration management and enable Infrastructure as Code through deployment tools.
  • Own and manage the build and release cycle for customer projects.
  • Share responsibility for deploying releases and other operations and maintenance activities.
  • Improve operations infrastructure: Jenkins clusters, Bitbucket, monitoring tools (Consul), and metrics tools like Graphite and Grafana.
  • Provide operational support for the engineering team and help migrate legacy infrastructure to the cloud.
  • Establish and enforce operational best practices, including monitoring for automated system health checks.
  • Build scalable infrastructure for data platforms-Amazon EMR, Redshift, and SageMaker.
  • Build our CI pipeline, and train and guide the team in DevOps practices.

What are we looking for?

  • 4+ years of experience using Terraform for IaaC.
  • 4+ years of configuration management and engineering for large-scale customers, ideally supporting an Agile development process.
  • 4+ years of Linux or Windows administration experience.
  • 4+ years with version control systems (git), including branching and merging strategies.
  • 2+ years of experience working with AWS infrastructure and platform services.
  • 2+ years of experience with cloud automation tools (Ansible, Chef).
  • Exposure to container services on AWS: Kubernetes, ECS, and EKS.
  • A proactive eye for what can be made more reliable — and the follow-through to make it so.

You will be preferred if

  • Expertise across multiple cloud providers: Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform.
  • AWS Solutions Architect Professional or Associate certification.
  • AWS DevOps Professional certification.

How we work?

We run a forward-deployed model: engineers embed with delivery teams, own their piece of the outcome, and ship against committed dates. This is a remote freelance engagement, so we'll be straight about the shape: you work project-by-project inside that model, with Aedeon absorbing the repetitive layer so your time goes to infrastructure judgment, not checklist work. You'll work independently, coordinate closely with the engagement team, and your automation will carry production traffic for named customers.

The Senior Manager, Commercial Capabilities is a hands-on leader responsible for managing and optimizing the tools and platforms that support the US Commercial organization. Reporting to the Sr. Director, Commercial Planning & PMO, this role is focused on CRM administration and roadmap ownership for Commercial technology improvements. The Senior Manager will work closely with Commercial leadership, IT, and external vendors to maintain and enhance our Commercial technologies.

The ideal candidate brings either solid software engineering experience applied to Commercial systems, or strong process operations skills with hands-on experience in enterprise technology platforms — paired in both cases with cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to lead a small team.

Commercial Systems Operations & Planning

  • Own release management, platform documentation, and end-user training to ensure adoption and data integrity

AI Roadmap for Commercial

  • Partner with IT, Data, and external vendors to evaluate AI solutions; lead pilots and define the criteria for scale.

Cross-Functional Stakeholder Collaboration

Team & Vendor Coordination

  • Perform related duties as assigned, within your scope of practice

PERSONAL AND PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS:

We are open to candidates from two primary backgrounds — what matters most is the combination of systems thinking, collaborative leadership, and a track record of delivery.

Process Architecture / Operations Track

  • 8+ years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, commercial strategy, or management consulting with a strong technology component
  • Strong process design skills — ability to map and operationalize commercial workflows across organizations
  • Proven ability to define requirements for and oversee delivery of systems projects
  • Experience coordinating with technical development teams or vendors against a defined roadmap
  • Solid fluency with enterprise platforms (CRM, ERP, BI/analytics) and ability to support technology evaluation decisions

Account Executive, Higher Education

CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We have trained over 40,000 students from 1,000+ universities. Our partners include Amazon, Google, Meta, and 4,000+ companies across the industry. We’ve been training the next generation of technical talent for nearly a decade, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world.

We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work.

We are building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact for a generation of technical talent who have historically been locked out of tech. If you want to own something and be part of a 0-to-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, we think you’d love it here. 

About the Role

Location: Remote, United States

Role Type: Full-Time

Reporting to: Head of Higher Education

Compensation: $110,000 – $150,000 base salary

  • plus variable compensation tied to new-partner targets. On-target earnings (OTE): ~$200,000.

CodePath is bringing its proven model to far more campuses than we reach today. Tens of thousands of Computer Science students need our programs to compete in an AI-native workforce, and the limiting factor is the number of colleges in our network. This role exists to grow that network by signing new campus partners.

You will own new-logo acquisition for the higher education channel: generating your own pipeline, running full sales cycles, and closing partnerships with colleges and universities. You will spend most of your time in front of Computer Science faculty, department chairs, and academic leaders, so you need to speak their language and earn credibility fast.

You like drumming up new business. You work conferences, open doors that were closed, and get a room of skeptical faculty interested in what CodePath can do for their students. You don’t wait for inbound. Expect travel ~1-2x / quarter. 

You report to the Head of Higher Education. 

Key Activities

  • Own a new-partner target: build and manage pipeline from prospecting through signed agreement 
  • Run full sales cycles end to end: outbound outreach, discovery, program demonstration, proposal, negotiation, and close
  • Identify and engage Computer Science faculty, department chairs, and academic decision-makers; map program fit and build the internal case for partnership
  • Translate CodePath's curriculum, technical rigor, and student outcomes credibly to a CS faculty audience
  • Navigate academic procurement and budget cycles to move deals to close on a predictable timeline
  • Partner with the Head of Higher Education on territory strategy, target account lists, and deal strategy
  • Maintain accurate pipeline, activity, and forecast data in HubSpot

Qualifications

Required

  • Hunter mentality: you generate your own pipeline, energize prospects, and chase down new business; you do not wait for inbound and you are motivated by closing new partners
  • 3–5 years in full-cycle sales, with a track record of closing net-new accounts

  • CRM discipline: you keep HubSpot or an equivalent CRM accurate and use it to forecast

Preferred

1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

As a Senior CSM at 1Password, you own and strategically manage a portfolio of customers – driving value realization, revenue retention, and expansion outcomes that consistently exceed expectations. You operate with full commercial autonomy: advancing expansion opportunities independently, engaging VP and C-suite stakeholders as a trusted advisor, and managing complex renewals without escalation. Beyond your own book, you raise the bar for the team through mentorship, playbook contributions, and peer enablement.

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

What we're looking for:

  • Demonstrated track record of exceeding retention, adoption, and expansion outcomes; experience recognized with performance distinction is a plus.

Own and Grow Your Book of Business

  • Independently manage a portfolio of moderately to highly complex accounts – adapting success plans to each customer’s context without manager guidance.

Drive Adoption & Value Realization

  • Achieve strong Executive Sponsor attendance in EBRs across segments; EBRs are value-driven, data-backed, and consistently advance renewal confidence.

  • Translate advanced 1Password capabilities into clear outcomes for VP and C-suite stakeholders; tie adoption to measurable ROI and long-term advocacy.

Lead Revenue Retention & Expansion

  • Maintain forecasting hygiene with minimal blank or unmodified renewals approaching subscription end.

Act as a Trusted Security Advisor

Marketing Technology Engineer

JOB SUMMARY

As a Marketing Technology Engineer, you will own Hello Alice's marketing technology stack. Embedded on the marketing team, you keep our email systems running reliably, ship website and CMS changes without waiting on an engineering queue, and apply AI across the stack to do work that historically required a dedicated engineer.

This role reflects how Hello Alice builds: technical and AI capability embedded in operating teams, not isolated in a specialist function. You are a marketer's engineer and an engineer's marketer. You understand marketing systems, are comfortable in code, and treat AI as a daily working tool.

You will also help lead our evaluation of in-house alternatives to parts of the stack, beginning with email. Reporting into marketing, you work closely with engineering on shared standards and integrations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Marketing Systems Operations

  • Email Platform Ownership: Own email operations in Salesforce Marketing Cloud: sends, journeys, automations, segmentation, data hygiene, and deliverability. Maintain the QA discipline required for systems that reach nearly 1.5 million business owners.
  • Stack Administration & Integration: Administer the stack end-to-end, including integrations among the ESP, CMS, analytics, and the core platform. Keep data flows trustworthy and hold marketing systems to the same security, privacy, and accessibility standards as the rest of the platform.

Website & Campaign Delivery

  • Marketing Website Development: Ship website changes with marketing associates, working directly in our headless CMS (Payload) and in code, so routine changes land in days, not sprints. Manage content models and the editorial experience so associates can self-serve routine content work.
  • Campaign Enablement: Build the segments, dynamic content, forms, and measurement that campaigns depend on. Turn recurring requests into reusable, self-service capabilities.

Applied AI & Platform Evolution

  • AI-Powered Marketing Operations: Apply AI across the stack to automate operations, generate and review code, and find leverage the team has not thought of yet. Prioritize by measurable gains in quality, capacity, speed, or cost, within Hello Alice's AI standards and governance.
  • Build-vs-Buy Evaluation: Evaluate and prototype in-house alternatives to parts of the stack, starting with email. Ensure build-vs-buy decisions honestly account for deliverability, compliance, and operational burden alongside cost.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & CAPABILITIES

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As Vanta continues to grow, winning in the International markets will be critical. We’re just starting to establish our EMEA presence, and we need talented and customer focused Account Executives who are excited to help build and grow a large and untapped UK&I markets as we continue to distinguish Vanta as best-in-class to prospects in a burgeoning competitive landscape.

If this sounds like you, and you’re excited to be a part of our founding sales team in EMEA, we'd love to hear from you.

What you’ll do as an Account Executive at Vanta:

  • Own your pipeline from the ground up — identify, research, and prioritize high-potential accounts and verticals, building a consistent outbound motion to create new opportunities.

  • Run a world-class sales process — qualify deeply, forecast accurately, and progress deals using MEDDPICC or a similar structured methodology to drive predictable outcomes.

  • Convert interest into long-term value — educate prospects on the business impact of Vanta, deliver compelling demos, and tailor solution recommendations to each customer’s goals.

  • Communicate with executive presence — engage confidently with founders, CEOs, and technical leaders, translating complex compliance and security concepts into clear business value.

  • Continuously sharpen your craft — act on feedback, seek coaching, and contribute to improving team playbooks, messaging, and outbound best practices.

  • Be a self-starter who makes things happen — operate with urgency, ownership, and autonomy in a fast-moving environment where results matter.

  • Champion market expansion — explore partnership opportunities, represent Vanta at industry events, and help us deepen our presence in new and existing markets.

  • Cross-Functional — working alongside our SDR team, marketing team, legal and Solutions Engineers to find, run and win deals.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 3+ years closing experience

  • Have had a closing and quota-carrying role in the past, while consistently exceeding monthly and quarterly sales targets

  • Be experienced in B2B SaaS, preferably in SMB and Mid-Market

  • Be highly curious, seeking to understand customers, their needs and how best Vanta can help them

  • Possess the technical competency to understand Vanta’s software and build great relationships with highly technical prospects

  • Have stellar problem-solving skills, and an enthusiasm for making a large impact early on at a start-up

  • Have entrepreneurial spirit, initiative and autonomy so you can make a huge contribution to the EMEA landing team

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

  • Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. jobs.title: Principal Data Scientist - Consumer
jobs.description:
Principal Data Scientist - Consumer

Gopuff delivers everyday essentials in minutes from our own network of micro-fulfillment centers. Every session, a customer sees a small, fast-changing assortment that depends on where they are, what's in stock, and what they need right now. Getting that experience right is one of our biggest levers for growth.

As Principal Data Scientist, Consumer, you will be the technical lead for how Gopuff personalizes the shopping experience. You will design and ship the recommendation, ranking, and personalization models behind search, browse, carts, and marketing, and you will lead our work on agentic AI experiences for consumers. You will set technical direction, mentor data scientists, and partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Marketing leaders.

What We Offer

  • Medical/Dental/Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
  • HSA or FSA eligibility
  • Long and Short-Term Disability Insurance
  • Fitness Reimbursement Program
  • 25% employee discount & FAM Membership
  • Flexible PTO
  • Group Life Insurance
  • EAP through AllOne Health (formerly Carebridge)

What You'll Do

  • Own consumer personalization end to end. Define the modeling strategy for recommendations, ranking, and personalization across the home feed, search, product pages, cart, and CRM.

  • Build recommenders and rankers. Design candidate generation, retrieval, and learning-to-rank systems that balance relevance, basket size, margin, and real-time inventory availability.

  • Lead agentic AI for consumers. Build LLM-powered agents that help customers plan, discover, and reorder (for example, turning "taco night for six" into a ready cart), including tool use, retrieval, evaluation, and guardrails.

  • Blend classic ML and LLMs. Decide when a gradient-boosted model, a two-tower network, or an LLM is the right tool, and combine them in production systems.

  • Run rigorous experiments. Design A/B tests and offline evaluation frameworks, choose the right metrics, and connect model gains to customer and business outcomes.

  • Ship to production. Partner with engineers and product managers on feature pipelines, model serving, latency budgets, and monitoring for drift and quality.

  • Set the bar. Mentor senior and staff data scientists, lead design reviews, and raise standards for modeling, code quality, and measurement across the team.

  • Shape the roadmap. Work with Product and Engineering leaders to choose the problems with the highest impact and explain trade-offs clearly to executives.

What You'll Bring

  • 10+ years of experience in data science or machine learning, or 8+ years with a PhD in a quantitative field (computer science, statistics, operations research, or similar).

  • A track record of shipping recommendation, ranking, or personalization systems that measurably moved consumer metrics at scale.

  • Deep knowledge of classic machine learning: gradient boosting, collaborative filtering, matrix factorization, learning-to-rank, embeddings, and causal and experimental methods.

  • Hands-on experience building agentic AI systems with LLMs, including prompt and tool design, retrieval-augmented generation, multi-step agents, and evaluation of agent quality and safety.

  • Expert Python skills and fluency with the core ML stack (for example pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost or LightGBM, PyTorch or TensorFlow).

  • Strong SQL and experience working with large data warehouses; hands-on experience with Snowflake.

  • Comfortable using AI coding assistants such as Claude to build models and pipelines faster, with the judgment to review, test, and validate AI-generated code and to protect customer data.

  • Solid grounding in A/B testing, offline-to-online metric alignment, and statistical inference.

  • Experience leading technical direction across teams without direct authority, and mentoring senior data scientists.

  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical partners, including executives.

Nice to Have

jobs.title: Business Development Representative - UK (Apono)
jobs.description:
Business Development Representative - UK (Apono)

1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Apono is now part of 1Password. Together, we’re shaping the future of identity security for humans, machines, and AI agents. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work. We deliver just-in-time, just-enough access governance, unleashing productivity without compromising security. If you’re excited to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals and solve hard problems at scale, come join us and help build a safer, simpler digital future for everyone.

Join a small, growing Business Development Representative (BDR) team supporting Account Executives (AEs) who work with small and midsize businesses across the UK/EMEA. You’ll help create new business opportunities through thoughtful prospecting, qualify potential customers, and build the skills needed for a successful career in Go-To-Market (GTM) sales. Your work will help organizations protect access to their cloud environments through 1Password’s security solutions.

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

Expectations of this role
This is a hybrid role. You will be expected to work from 1Password's London office 3 days per week, with the flexibility to work from the office up to 5 days based on business needs.

What we're looking for:

You do not need prior sales experience to be successful in this role. We value transferable experience, coachability, and a willingness to learn.

  • Communicate clearly and professionally in phone, email, and written conversations.

  • Demonstrate strong prospecting and cold-calling skills, with the ability to engage new contacts respectfully.

  • Show resilience, organization, and consistency in a high-volume outbound environment.

  • Respond openly to coaching and apply feedback to improve performance.

  • Manage multiple prospect interactions while maintaining accurate and organized records.

Preferred

  • Experience in Business Development Representative, Sales Development Representative, customer service, teaching, retail, hospitality, military, athletics, or another customer-facing environment.

  • Familiarity with Software as a Service (SaaS), cloud security, Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems, sales engagement platforms, or prospecting tools.

What you can expect:

  • Execute outbound prospecting through phone calls, email, LinkedIn, and other channels.

  • Use artificial intelligence (AI)-driven sales tools and modern prospecting platforms to work efficiently and engage prospects thoughtfully.

  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads against defined criteria and build a sustainable pipeline.

  • Schedule qualified meetings and provide focused day-to-day support to Account Executives.

  • Maintain accurate records of prospect activity and follow-up in the CRM.

  • Represent the company at industry events and trade shows when relevant.

  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing partners while participating in ongoing coaching, training, and enablement.

UK-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between £35,000 GBP and £49,000 GBP, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, pension, and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.


Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.


What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community
🤝 Paid volunteer days
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at ----- and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.
